Formulado com uma cera especial de alto teor de soja que queima mais limpa do que parafina, e com fragrâncias naturais à base de óleo essencial que queimam ricamente e uniformemente preenchem o espaço com fragrância. Cada vela é feita em um vaso de vidro soprado à mão cujas linhas sofisticadas e cores vibrantes complementam qualquer espaço, muito depois que a cera queime.

LAFCO 蠟燭具有香味、性能和美學特性 - 旨在增強熟悉、心愛的空間的心情,而不會過度施加或干擾。 我們的蠟燭在美國手工倒入,經過優化,可燃燒 90 小時。 配方採用特種高大豆含量蠟,比石蠟燃燒更乾淨,並採用天然精油香味,燃燒豐富,均勻充滿香味。 每一支蠟燭都是用手工吹製的藝術玻璃容器製成,其精緻的線條和鮮豔的色彩可在蠟燒焦之後為任何空間補充。

LAFCO 蜡烛 - 在香味、性能和美学中 - 旨在增强熟悉、喜爱的空间的氛围,不会过于力量或干扰。 我们的蜡烛在美国手工浇注,优化可燃烧 90 小时。 配方中加入了比石蜡更清洁的特殊高大豆含量蜡,以及天然精油香料,燃烧丰富均匀地充满香味。 每根蜡烛都是用手工吹制的艺术玻璃容器制成,其精致的线条和鲜艳的色彩将在蜡烛燃烧后很长一段时间内补充任何空间。

LAFCO 양초는 향수, 성능 및 미학으로 친숙하고 사랑받는 공간의 분위기를 향상시키도록 고안되었습니다. 저희 양초는 미국에서 손으로 부어 90시간 연소할 수 있도록 최적화되었습니다. 파라핀보다 더 깨끗하게 연소하는 특수 고콩 함량 왁스로 제조되었으며, 천연 에센셜 오일 기반 향기로 공간을 풍부하고 고르게 채워 줍니다. 각 양초는 손으로 불어 넣은 예술 유리 용기로 만들어져 정교한 라인과 생생한 색상이 왁스가 탄 후 오래 사용할 수 있습니다.

title: Bvlgari Man In Black by Bvlgari Eau De Parfum Spray 3.4 oz

description:
Bvlgari celebrates 130 years of existence and launches new fragrance Bvlgari Man In Black, as a flanker of the original Bvlgari Man from 2010. The fragrance is announced as bold and charismatic, inspired by the myth of the birth of Vulcan, the god of the earth, interpreted in a way that suits the modern man.

Bvlgari Man In Black is an intense composition of amber, leather, spices and woods. It opens with accords of natural rum and luminous spices. Tuberose, iris absolut and leather form the core of the perfume, placed on the base of benzoin, tonka bean and guaiac wood.

Bvlgari celebra 130 años de existencia y lanza nueva fragancia Bvlgari Man In Black, como un flanker del Bvlgari Man original de 2010. La fragancia se anuncia como audaz y carismática, inspirada en el mito del nacimiento de Vulcano, el dios de la tierra, interpretada de una manera que se adapte al hombre moderno.

Bvlgari Man In Black es una composición intensa de ámbar, cuero, especias y maderas. Se abre con acuerdos de ron natural y especias luminosas. Tuberosa, iris absolut y cuero forman el núcleo del perfume, colocado sobre la base de benzoína, haba tonka y madera de guayaco.

Bvlgari חוגגת 130 שנות קיום ומשיקה ניחוח חדש Bvlgari Man בשחור, כאגבה של איש Bvlgari המקורי משנת 2010. הניחוח הוכרז כנועז וכריזמטי, בהשראת המיתוס של לידתו של וולקן, אל כדור הארץ, מפורש באופן שמתאים לגבר המודרני.

Bvlgari Man In Black הוא הרכב אינטנסיבי של ענבר, עור, תבלינים ועצים. הוא נפתח עם אקורדים של רום טבעי ותבלינים זוהרים. פקעות, איריס אבסולוט ועור יוצרים את ליבת הבושם, מונח על בסיס בנזואין, שעועית טונקה ועץ גואיאק.

Bvlgari feiert 130 Jahre Existenz und bringt neuen Duft Bvlgari Man in Black auf den Markt, als Flanker des ursprünglichen Bvlgari Man aus dem Jahr 2010. Der Duft ist mutig und charismatisch angekündigt, inspiriert von dem Mythos der Geburt von Vulcan, dem Gott der Erde, interpretiert in einer Weise, die dem modernen Mann entspricht.

Bvlgari Man in Black ist eine intensive Komposition aus Bernstein, Leder, Gewürzen und Hölzern. Es öffnet sich mit Akkorden von natürlichem Rum und leuchtenden Gewürzen. Tuberose, Iris und Leder bilden den Kern des Parfums, platziert auf der Basis von Benzoin, Tonkabohne und Guajakholz.

Bvlgari는 130년의 존재를 기념하고 2010년부터 오리지널 불가리 맨의 플라커로 새로운 향수 Bvlgari Man In Black을 출시합니다. 이 향수는 대담하고 카리스마틱으로 발표되었으며, 지구의 신인 벌컨의 탄생의 신화에서 영감을 받아 현대인에게 맞는 방식으로 해석됩니다.

title: Mr. BURBERRY Men's Eau de Toilette Spray, 3.3 Fl Oz
bullet_point: [Mr. Burberry is an original product by Burberry., Packaging for this product may vary from that shown in the image above., This item is not for sale in Catalina Island.]
description:
Mr. Burberry. A man of contrasts. Classic yet contemporary; sophisticated and sensual. A sartorial elegance with a rebellious attitude. Authentic and British. London is his home, a city of subtlety and surprise. Like him, it is refined and elegant, not pristine or perfect. An energy and irreverence define their style. Mr. Burberry captures the essence of London and its moments, fusing classic scents of British perfumery with unexpected ingredients. Fresh and crafted top notes of crisp, zesty grapefruit, cut with a seductive base of earthy vetiver and smoky guaiac wood. The bottle is inspired by the iconic black Burberry trench coat, its quality, craftsmanship, style and timeless appeal. Celebrated for its innovative protective qualities and lauded for its versatility and durability. Bold and masculine, the weighted cap references horn-look buttons, while a hand-tied knot in English-woven black gabardine sits around the neck, celebrating the innovative fabric invented by Thomas Burberry more than 100 years ago.

מר בורברי. גבר של ניגודים. קלאסי אך עכשווי; מתוחכם וחושני. אלגנטיות מרדנית עם גישה מרדנית. אותנטי ובריטי. לונדון היא ביתו, עיר של עדינות והפתעה. כמוהו, הוא מעודן ואלגנטי, לא טהור או מושלם. אנרגיה ועצלות מגדירים את הסגנון שלהם. מר בורברי לוכד את המהות של לונדון ואת הרגעים שלה, משלב ניחוחות קלאסיים של בשמים בריטיים עם מרכיבים בלתי צפויים. ניחוחות עליונים רעננים ומעוצבים של אשכולית פריכה, נחתכות עם בסיס מפתה של vetiver אדמתית ועץ גואיאק מעושן. הבקבוק בהשראת מעיל הגשם האיקוני של Burberry שחור, האיכות, האומנות, הסגנון והמשיכה הנצחית. נחגג בשל איכויות ההגנה החדשניות שלו וזכה ברבגוניות ועמידותו. נועז וגברי, הכובע המשוקלל מתייחס ללחצנים במראה קרן, בעוד קשר קשור ביד בגברדין השחור הארוג האנגלי יושב סביב הצוואר, חוגג את הבד החדשני שהומצא על ידי תומס בורברי לפני יותר מ-100 שנה.

مستر بيربري. رجل من التناقضات. كلاسيكي وعصري وراقي ومثير. أناقة مميزة مع موقف متمرد. أصلي وبريطاني. لندن هي منزله، مدينة الخفية والمفاجأة. مثله ، إنه أنيق وأنيق ، ليس أصليًا أو مثاليًا. الطاقة والظهور تحدد أسلوبهم. يأسر مستر بيربري جوهر لندن ولحظاتها، حيث يمزج الروائح الكلاسيكية لعطور بريطانية بمكونات غير متوقعة. مكونات عليا منعشة ومصنوعة من الجريب فروت المنعش والقوي ومقصوصة بقاعدة مغرية من نجيل الهند وخشب الغاياك الدخاني. الزجاجة مستوحاة من معطف بيربري الأسود الأيقوني، الجودة والحرفية والأناقة وجاذبية دائمة. مشهور بخصائصه الواقية المبتكرة وأشاد بتنوع استخداماته ومتانته. جريء وذكوري، يشير الغطاء الثقيل إلى الأزرار ذات مظهر القرن، بينما عقدة مربوطة يدويًا في قماش الغبردان الأسود المنسوج باللغة الإنجليزية حول الرقبة، احتفالاً بالنسيج المبتكر الذي اخترعته توماس بيربري منذ أكثر من 100 عام.

Burberry 先生。 一個對比的人。 經典而現代;精緻而性感。 具有叛逆態度的服飾優雅。 正宗和英國。 London 是他的家,一個充滿微妙和驚喜的城市。 和他一樣,它精緻優雅,不是原始或完美。 能量和不敬決定了他們的風格。 Burberry 先生捕捉了倫敦的精髓及其時刻,將英國香水的經典香味與意想不到的成分融合在一起。 清新而精緻的前調,香脆、華麗的葡萄柚,以誘人的泥土香根和煙燻的瓜亞克木製成。 這款水瓶的靈感來自標誌性的黑色 Burberry 風衣,其品質、工藝、風格和永恆的吸引力。 以其創新的保護品質而聞名,並因其多功能性和耐用性而備受讚譽。 ​ 大膽而陽剛,加重帽參考了喇叭形鈕扣,而英國編織黑色頭巾的手工編織結在脖子上,慶祝 100 多年前由 Thomas Burberry 發明的創新布料。

description:
Since 1886, the famous motto 'the best or nothing' continues to live and the three-pointed star represents much more than an automobile company, it is a lifestyle & luxury brand elected the 9th most global/international famous brand in 2017. Mercedes-Benz is a name that signifies belonging. Belonging to a certain world. The world of creation and design, the world of beauty, rarity and exception. The brand's commitment to excellence in quality, innovative design, craftsmanship and performance has made a natural pursuit of advancing the areas of fashion and perfume for already 5 years. Indeed, fragrance and luxury have always been closely intertwined. More than all the other senses, the sense of smell determines whether we feel at ease with ourselves and in our surroundings. We keep this philosophy for our fragrances and we respect the noble codes of selective perfumery.

מאז 1886, המוטו המפורסם 'הטוב ביותר או כלום' ממשיך לחיות והכוכב בעל שלושת הצביע מייצג הרבה יותר מחברת רכב, זהו מותג אורח חיים ויוקרתי שנבחר את המותג העולמי ביותר / הבינלאומי המפורסם בשנת 2017. מרצדס-בנץ הוא שם המסמל שייכות. שייכות לעולם מסוים. עולם היצירה והעיצוב, עולם היופי, הנדירות והיוצא מן הכלל. המחויבות של המותג למצוינות באיכות, עיצוב חדשני, אומנות וביצועים עשו מרדף טבעי לקידום תחומי האופנה והבושם כבר 5 שנים. אכן, ניחוח ויוקרה תמיד שזורים זה בזה. יותר מכל החושים האחרים, חוש הריח קובע אם אנחנו מרגישים בנוח עם עצמנו ובסביבתנו. אנו שומרים על הפילוסופיה הזו על הניחוחות שלנו ואנו מכבדים את הקודים האציליים של בשמים סלקטיביים.

Seit 1886 lebt das berühmte Motto "das Beste oder nichts" weiter und der dreipackige Stern repräsentiert viel mehr als ein Automobil-Unternehmen, es ist eine Lifestyle-& Luxus-Marke gewählt, die im Jahr 2017 die 9. global/international berühmteste Marke gewählt hat. Mercedes-Benz ist ein Name, der die Zugehörigkeit bedeutet. Zu einer bestimmten Welt gehören. Die Welt der Kreation und des Designs, die Welt der Schönheit, Seltenheit und Ausnahme. Das Engagement der Marke für Exzellenz in Qualität, innovatives Design, Handwerkskunst und Leistung hat seit 5 Jahren ein natürliches Streben nach der Weiterentwicklung der Bereiche Mode und Parfüm unterzogen. Duft und Luxus sind schon immer eng miteinander verflochten. Mehr als alle anderen Sinne bestimmt der Geruchssinn ob wir uns mit uns und in unserer Umgebung wohlfühlen. Wir behalten diese Philosophie für unsere Düfte und wir respektieren die edlen Codes der selektiven Parfümerie.

منذ عام 1886، يستمر الشعار الشهير "الأفضل أو لا شيئ" في الحياة، ويمثل النجمة الثلاثية أكثر بكثير من شركة سيارات، وهي علامة تجارية فاخرة لأسلوب الحياة تم انتخابها العلامة التجارية الأكثر شهرة عالميًا/عالميًا في عام 2017. مرسيدس بنز هو اسم يشير إلى انتقائه. ينتمي إلى عالم معين. عالم الإبداع والتصميم، عالم الجمال والفخامة والاستثناء. لقد سعى العلامة التجارية للتميز في الجودة والتصميم المبتكر والحرفية والأداء بشكل طبيعي لتحقيق التقدم في مجال الموضة والعطور منذ 5 سنوات فما فوق. في الواقع، العطر والرفاهية متداخلتان بشكل وثيق دائماً. أكثر من جميع الحواس الأخرى، فإن الإحساس بالرائحة يحدد ما إذا كنت تشعر بالراحة مع أنفسنا وفي محيطنا. نحن نحتفظ بهذه الفلسفة لعطورنا ونحن نحترم الرموز النبيلة لصناعة العطور الانتقائية.

Soy Ink Print on Biodegradable and Recyclable Packaging. Starting a personal care company on a few thousand dollars, in a log cabin on a dirt road with no internet and a questionable phone line, could be classified as crazy. The fact that we were broke wasnt a plus. After ruining all our hand-me-down pots and pans developing our first formulae, hand filling our first bottles of shave cream and taking our first order to the local rural post office where we were greeted with long stares; we got it running. After years of work and countless hours fighting with many of our suppliers who said it couldnt be done, we achieved the first certified organic personal care facility in the US and offered recyclable packaging -- both revolutionary to the personal care market. Some may wonder why we do all of this. Our answer: We realize everyday millions of tons of personal care products are used globally which could be made much healthier for humans and the environment. We wanted to create personal care products that are both healthy and have minimal environmental impact. We believe small changes in our everyday routine, like switching a can of aerosol shave cream to a recyclable tube of organic shave cream, can collectively have a long-term dramatic benefit to human health and the environment. People think it is fancy now that our products are carried by noted retailers, shipped internationally and mentioned in magazines; but, the reality is were just happy that Organic Grooming products contribute to the growing environmental movement by making it easy for people to Go Green. description:
Seductive RUSSIAN PRESENT Magic carries you away to the blooming garden to enjoy a fascinating bouquet of floral and fresh green aromas.

The history of creation and philosophy of the fragrance:
During the last few years Sergio Nero perfumers repeatedly paid their attention to the idea of original Russian perfume.
It seems quite easy at first glance, but how can you make a fragrance reflect mysterious Russian soul? This became a real challenge.
They say that Russian women are very beautiful and attractive, but how do you embody this beauty in a perfume and share it with other women?
Nothing is impossible to a willing heart! Together with European perfumers we managed to create eau de parfum with a Russian character.
It won’t make you more Russian than you are now, but your Man can’t resist the alluring scented notes. It won’t give you a clue to the secret of Russian soul, but it will enveil you with a touch of mystery.
In December 2016 the Embassy of France in Moscow hosted the awards ceremony to honor the winners of the annual professional contest FIFI Russian Fragrance Awards 2016, where Russian Present perfume line won 2 nominations at once.

Each fragrance from the Russian Present Perfume Oils collection reveals its essence layer by layer, just like the famous Russian Matryoshka doll. It allows combination with other fragrances for you to create a unique, magical aroma, as makeup artists use liners, glosses, glitters, etc.

ATTENTION: The oil version of the perfume is different from Eau de Parfum! The dominant notes in the perfume oil are powdery peony, sweet white flowers and musk.
To create harmony of the chords of the fragrances, you should apply the selected fragrance on the pulse area of your wrist and on the top of this, apply a strip of Russian Present Magic oil. After 5-10 seconds, listen to the breath of the newly born chord and check again after several hours.

title: Paloma Picasso Eau De Parfum Spray For Women, 3.4 Ounce
bullet_point: [The fragrance opens with a fresh and spicy note of coriander, angelica and carnation., This a fragrant self-portrait., This perfume is an elegant floral chypre]
description:
The perfume created by Paloma Picasso - the daughter of the famous painter. This a fragrant self-portrait. Her maternal grandfather was a perfumer, so, as a child, she was familiar with combining smells, creating scents. Her artistic talent is something she inherited from her father, therefore she was very successful in her work as a jewelry designer for Yves Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co. Her favorite perfume is Chanel Nº 5, so she wanted to create a perfume with an aldehydic accord. Red is her favorite color and black is a symbol of power. This perfume is an elegant floral chypre with a Mediterranian temperament, but because the perfume was very complex, it was very hard to market. She was afraid that her associates would change the formula, but luckily, this didn’t happen. The fragrance opens with a fresh and spicy note of coriander, angelica and carnation. Aldehydes are in harmony with ylang ylang, jasmine and hyacinth. Woody notes of oakmoss, patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver, and tobacco blend with original animal notes (castoreum, civet, and musk).

El perfume creado por Paloma Picasso - la hija del famoso pintor. Este es un autorretrato fragante. Su abuelo materno era perfumista, por lo que, cuando era niño, estaba familiarizada con combinar olores, creando aromas. Su talento artístico es algo que heredó de su padre, por lo que tuvo mucho éxito en su trabajo como diseñador de joyas para Yves Saint Laurent y Tiffany & Co. Su perfume favorito es Chanel Nº 5, por lo que quería crear un perfume con un acuerdo aldehídico. El rojo es su color favorito y el negro es un símbolo de poder. Este perfume es un elegante chipre floral con un temperamento mediterráneo, pero debido a que el perfume era muy complejo, era muy difícil de comercializar. Tenía miedo de que sus asociados cambiaran la fórmula, pero afortunadamente, esto no sucedió. La fragancia se abre con una nota fresca y picante de cilantro, angélica y clavel. Aldehídos están en armonía con ylang ylang, jazmín y jacinto. Notas amaderadas de musgo de roble, pachulí, sándalo, vetiver y tabaco se mezclan con notas animales originales (castóreo, civet y almizcle).

Das Parfüm, das von Paloma Picasso kreiert wurde - der Tochter des berühmten Malers. Dies ist ein duftendes Selbstporträt. Ihr mütterlicher Großvater war Parfümeur, also war sie als Kind vertraut, Gerüche zu kombinieren und Düfte zu erzeugen. Ihr künstlerisches Talent ist etwas, das sie von ihrem Vater geerbt hat, daher war sie sehr erfolgreich in ihrer Arbeit als Schmuckdesigner für Yves Saint Laurent und Tiffany & Co. Ihr Lieblingsparfüm ist Chanel Nº 5, also wollte sie ein Parfüm mit einem aldehydischen Einklang kreieren. Rot ist ihre Lieblingsfarbe und Schwarz ist ein Symbol der Macht. Dieses Parfüm ist ein eleganter blumiger Chypre mit mediterranem Temperament, aber weil das Parfüm sehr komplex war, war es sehr schwer zu vermarkten. Sie hatte Angst, dass ihre Mitarbeiter die Formel ändern würden, aber zum Glück passierte dies nicht. Der Duft öffnet sich mit einer frischen und würzigen Note von Koriander, Angelica und Nelke. Aldehyde sind im Einklang mit Ylang-Ylang, Jasmin und Hyazinthe. Holzige Noten von Eichenmoos, Patchouli, Sandelholz, Vetiver und Tabak Mischung mit originellen Tiernoten (Ciborum, Zivet und Moschus).

العطر الذي ابتكره بالوما بيكاسو - ابنة الرسام الشهيرة. هذه صورة ذاتية عطرية. كان جدها الأم صانع عطر، لذا كطفل كانت على دراية بجمع الروائح مما يخلق الروائح. موهبتها الفنية هي شيء ترثه من والدها، لذلك كانت ناجحة للغاية في عملها كمصمم مجوهرات لإيف سان لوران وتيفاني آند كو. عطرها المفضل هو شانيل رقم 5، لذلك أرادت صنع عطر مع مزيج الألدهيد. الأحمر هو لونها المفضل والأسود هو رمز السلطة. هذا العطر هو قبرصي زهور أنيق مع مزاج البحر المتوسط، ولكن بسبب كان العطر معقدًا للغاية، كان من الصعب جدًا تسويقه. كانت خائفة من أن زملائها سيغيرون التركيبة، ولكن لحسن الحظ لم يحدث ذلك. يبدأ العطر برائحة منعشة ولاذعة من الكزبرة والانجليكا والقرنفل. تتناغم الألدهيدات مع الإيلانج والياسمين والياسمين. مزيج الروائح الخشبية من طحلب السنديان والباتشولي وخشب الصندل ونجيل الهند والتبغ مع روائح الحيوانات الأصلية (الكاستوريوم والزباد والمسك).

O perfume criado por Paloma Picasso – a filha do famoso pintor. Este é um auto-retrato perfumado. Seu avô materno era um perfumista, então, quando criança, ela estava familiarizada com a combinação de cheiros, criando perfumes. Seu talento artístico é algo que ela herdou de seu pai, portanto ela foi muito bem-sucedida em seu trabalho como designer de joias para Yves Saint Laurent e Tiffany & Co. Seu perfume favorito é Chanel Nº 5, então ela queria criar um perfume com um acorde aldeídico. O vermelho é sua cor favorita e o preto é um símbolo de poder. Este perfume é um chipre floral elegante com um temperamento mediterrânico, mas como o perfume era muito complexo, era muito difícil de comercializar. Ela tinha medo de que seus parceiros mudassem a fórmula, mas, felizmente, isso não aconteceu. A fragrância abre com uma nota fresca e picante de coentro, angélica e cravo. Os aldeídos estão em harmonia com ylang ylang, jasmim e jacinto. Notas amadeiradas de musgo de carvalho, patchouli, sândalo, vetivo e tabaco se misturam com notas originais de animais (castóreo, civet e almíscar).

由 Paloma Picasso 創作的香水 - 著名畫家的女兒。 這是一款芬芳的自拍照。 她的祖父是一名香水,所以在孩子時,她熟悉結合氣味,創造香味。 她的藝術才華是她從父親那裡繼承的東西,因此她在 Yves Saint Laurent 和 Tiffany & Co. 的一名珠寶設計師中非常成功。 她最喜歡的香水是 Chanel Nº 5,所以她想要創造一款具有甲醛的香水。 紅色是她最喜歡的顏色,黑色是力量的象徵。 這款香水是一款優雅的花朵,帶有地中海風情,但由於香水非常複雜,因此很難上市。 她害怕她的同事會改變公式,但幸運的是,這並沒有發生。 香味打開時帶有香菜、天使和康乃馨的清新辛辣香調。 甲醛與依蘭、茉莉和風鈴相稱。 木本香調的橡苔、廣藿香、檀香、香根香根和菸草混合原始動物香調(蓖麻、香茅和麝香)。

description:
Prada Amber Pour Homme is the first Prada fragrance, launched after the female one, also in oriental composition based upon amber. The perfumer Daniela Roche-Andrier created the composition in four basic accords : Amber – the main accord, rich and complex oriental base which includes amber, vanilla, labdanum, Tonka and patchouli; Fougere – or the aromatic accord with a remarkable soapy note, includes notes of pelargonium, vetiver, orange blossom and myrrh at the heart; Cologne – the refreshing citrusy top of bergamot, mandarin, neroli and cardamom; Leather – leather note is present at the base of the composition ( leather, saffron and sandalwood). Miuccia Prada, the granddaughter of the founder, who turned grandfather’s leather goods design into a large company, personally took part in creating of this perfume. “"I just tried to imagine what I would like if I were a man. ” Maybe due to the fact that it was created by a female hand, the fragrance is not aggressive at all, like it might have been expected from an oriental fragrance with leather and amber. Instead, it is very elegant and masculine gentle. Prada Amber Pour Homme (Prada Man) was created by Daniela (Roche) Andrier and Miuccia Prada. This product is manufactured in Spain.

Prada Amber Pour Homme הוא הניחוח הראשון של פראדה, שהושק לאחר הנקבה, גם בהרכב מזרחי המבוסס על ענבר. הבשם Daniela Roche-Andrier יצר את ההרכב בארבעה אקורדים בסיסיים: Amber – התור העיקרי, בסיס מזרחי עשיר ומורכב הכולל ענבר, וניל, labdanum, Tonka ופצ'ולי; Fougere – או הסכם הארומטי עם פתק סבון יוצא מן הכלל, כולל פתקים של פלרגוניום, vetiver, פריחת תפוז ו mymymymyvere. rrh ב לב; קולון – החלק העליון המרענן של ברגמוט, מנדרינה, נרולי והל; עור – תו עור נמצא בבסיס ההרכב (עור, זעפרן ואלגום). Miuccia Prada, נכדתה של המייסד, שהפכו את מוצרי העור של סבא לחברה גדולה, השתתפו באופן אישי ביצירת הבושם הזה. "רק ניסיתי לדמיין מה הייתי רוצה אם הייתי גבר". אולי בשל העובדה שהוא נוצר על ידי יד נשית, הניחוח אינו אגרסיבי בכלל, כאילו הוא היה צפוי מניחוח מזרחי עם עור וענבר. במקום זאת, הוא מאוד אלגנטי ועדין גברי. Prada Amber Pour Homme (Prada Man) נוצר על ידי Daniela (Roche) Andrier ו-Miuccia Prada. מוצר זה מיוצר בספרד.

Prada Amber Pour Homme ist der erste Prada-Duft, der nach der weiblichen entstanden ist, auch in orientalischer Komposition auf Bernstein. Der Parfümeur Daniela Roche-Andrier hat die Komposition in vier Basisakkorden geschaffen: Amber – der Hauptakkord, reichhaltige und komplexe orientalische Basis mit Bernstein, Vanille, Labdanum, Tonka und Patchouli – oder der aromatische Akzent mit einer bemerkenswerten Seifennote, enthält Noten von Pelargonium, Vetiver, Orangenblüte und Myrrhe im Herz; Köln - Die erfrischende Zitrusspitze aus Bergamotte, Mandarine, Neroli und Kardamom; Ledernote ist an der Basis der Komposition (Leder, Safran und Sandelholz). Miuccia Prada, die Enkelin der Gründerin, die das Design der Lederwaren des Großvaters in ein großes Unternehmen verwandelt hat, nahm persönlich an der Schaffung dieses Parfüms teil. "Ich habe gerade versucht, sich vorzustellen, was ich möchte, wenn ich ein Mann wäre." Vielleicht aufgrund der Tatsache, dass er von einer weiblichen Hand hergestellt wurde, ist der Duft überhaupt nicht aggressiv, wie er von einem orientalischen Duft mit Leder und Bernstein erwartet wurde. Stattdessen ist es sehr elegant und maskulin sanft. Prada Amber Pour Homme (Prada Man) wurde von Daniela (Roche) Andrier und Miuccia Prada kreiert. Hergestellt in Spanien.

عطر برادا امبر بور هوم هو أول عطر برادا، تم إطلاقه بعد عطر انثى، وأيضًا بتركيبة شرقية تعتمد على العنبر. ابتكر صانع العطر دانيلا روش - أندرير التركيبة في أربع روائح أساسية: العنبر - العطر الرئيسي والقاعدة الشرقية الغنية والمعقدة التي تشمل العنبر والفانيلا واللابدانوم والتونكا والباتشولي، أو الفوجير - أو الروائح العطرية مع رائحة صابون رائعة، تتضمن روائح البرجانيوم، نجيل الهند، زهر البرتقال والمر في القلب؛ الكولونيا - الجزء العلوي من الحمضيات المنعشة من البرغموت واليوسفي، زهر البرتقال والهالهال. ؛ الجلد - رائحة جلدية موجودة في قاعدة التركيبة (الجلد والزعفران وخشب الصندل). ميوكسيا برادا، حفيدة المؤسسة، التي حوّلت تصميم سلع الجد الجلدية إلى شركة كبيرة، شاركت شخصيًا في ابتكار هذا العطر. "حاولت للتو تخيل ما تريد إذا كنت رجلًا." ربما بسبب أنه تم صنعه بواسطة يد أنثوية، فإن العطر ليس عنيفاً على الإطلاق، كما هو متوقع من عطر شرقي مع الجلد والعنبر. بدلاً من ذلك، فهو أنيق للغاية ولطيف على الذكور. برادا امبر بور هوم (برادا مان) من قبل دانييلا (روشي) أندرير وميوشيا برادا. صُنع هذا المنتج في إسبانيا.

Prada Amber Pour Homme é a primeira fragrância Prada, lançada após a fêmea, também em composição oriental baseada em âmbar. A perfumista Daniela Roche-Andrier criou a composição em quatro acordos básicos: Âmbar – a base oriental rica e complexa que inclui âmbar, baunilha, labdano, Tonka e patchouli; Fougere – ou o acordo aromático com uma notável nota de sabão, inclui notas de pelargônio, vetiver, flor de laranja e mirra no coração; Colônias – o refrescante topo cítrico de bergamota, tangerina, neroli e cardamomo; couro – nota de couro está presente na base da composição (couro, açafrão e sândalo). Miuccia Prada, neta do fundador, que transformou o design de produtos de couro do avô em uma grande empresa, participou pessoalmente da criação deste perfume. "Eu só tentei imaginar o que eu gostaria se eu fosse um homem." Talvez devido ao fato de que ela foi criada por uma mão feminina, a fragrância não é agressiva, como pode ter sido esperada de uma fragrância oriental com couro e âmbar. Em vez disso, é muito elegante e masculina. A Prada Amber Pour Homme (Prada Man) foi criada por Daniela (Roche) Andrier e Miuccia Prada. Este produto é fabricado em Espanha.

Prada Amber Pour Homme 是第一种 Prada 香水,在女性后推出,也以琥珀为基础的东方成分。 香水家 Daniela Roche-Andrier 以四种基本协议创建了组成:琥珀 - 主要的协议,丰富和复杂的东方基,包括琥珀,香草,拉达纳,tonka 和广藿香;Fougere - 或带有非凡的肥皂香调,包括武术、香根草、橙花和myrrh 的香调。 心形;古水 – 清爽的柑橘顶部由佛手柑、柑橘、橙花和小豆蔻制成;皮革–皮革笔记在成分的基础上(皮革、藏红花和檀香)。 创始人的孙女 Miuccia Prada 将祖父的皮革产品设计变成一家大型公司,亲自参与了这种香水的创作。 "我只是试图想象一下我想要什么。" 也许由于它是由女性手创造的,香味根本没有侵略性,就像东方风情的皮革和琥珀香一样。 相反,它非常优雅和阳刚温和。 Prada Amber Pour Homme (Prada Man) 由 Daniela (Roche) Andrier 和 Miuccia Prada 创建。 本产品为西班牙制造。

Prada Amber Pour Homme 是第一款 Prada 香氛,在女性之後推出,也以琥珀為主。 香水家 Daniela Roche-Andrier 以四項基本協議創作了作品:琥珀 – 主要協議,豐富而複雜的東方基底,包括琥珀、香草、拉布丹姆、湯卡和廣藿香;Fougere – 或香皂香,包括提瓜、香根、橙花和 沒藥 心臟;古龍水 – 佛手柑、柑橘、橙花和小豆蔻的清新柑橘上衣;皮革 – 皮革音符出現在組成的底部 (皮革、番紅花和檀香)。 Miuccia Prada 是創辦人的孫女,將爺爺的皮革商品設計變成一家大型公司,親自參與了這種香水的創作。 「我只是試著想像一下,如果我是一個男人,我會想要什麼。」 也許由於是由女性手所創作,這種香味根本不具侵略性,就像是東方香味的皮革和琥珀。 相反,它非常優雅和陽剛的溫和。 Prada Amber Pour Homme(Prada Man)由 Daniela (Roche) Andrier 和 Miuccia Prada 創立。 本產品於西班牙製造。

프라다 앰버 푸어 옴므는 최초의 프라다 향기로, 여성 출시한 제품으로, 앰버를 기반으로 한 오리엔탈 구성으로도 출시되었습니다. 조향사 Daniela Roche-Andrier는 네 가지 기본 협약으로 구성을 만들었습니다. 호박, 바닐라, 라라브다늄, 통카, 파출리를 포함하는 풍부하고 복잡한 오리엔탈 베이스입니다. 푸제르 - 또는 놀라운 비누 노트와 아로마 조화를 이루고 있으며, 펠라고늄, 베티버, 오렌지 블로썸 및 몰약이 심장에 포함되어 있습니다. ; 향수 - 베르가못, 만다린, 네롤리 및 카르다몬의 상쾌한 시트러스 상단. 가죽 - 가죽 노트는 구성 베이스(가죽, 사프란 및 샌들우드)에 있습니다. 할아버지의 가죽 제품 디자인을 대기업으로 바꾸어 만든 창립자의 손녀인 Miuccia Prada는 개인적으로 이 향수를 만드는 데 참여했습니다. "나는 내가 남자라면 내가 원하는 것을 상상하려고 노력했다." 아마도 여성의 손에 의해 만들어졌다는 사실 때문에 향수는 전혀 공격적이지 않을 수도 있습니다. 가죽과 호박색의 오리엔탈 향기로 기대되었을 수도 있습니다. 대신, 매우 우아하고 남성적입니다. 프라다 앰버 푸어 옴므 (프라다 맨)는 다니엘라 (로슈) Andrier와 미우치아 프라다에 의해 만들어졌습니다. 이 제품은 스페인에서 제조되었습니다.

description: Parsley is a very bright, green and herbaceous scent with a distinctive twist, perfectly captured in this Pick-Me-Up spray. The Greeks held Parsley in high esteem, crowning the victors with wreaths of Parsley at some athletic contests, and making with it wreaths for adorning tombs. The herb was never brought to table as it was held sacred. סט סילון אמריקאי וסלבריטי טלוויזיה המציאות קים קים קרדשיאן השיקה את הבושם החדש שלה בשם גלאם שהוא האגף השלישי של הניחוח המקורי של קים קרדשיאן (השניים האחרים כוללים זהב ואהבה). גלאם הוא ניחוח פרחוני פירותי עם רקע עץ אבקתי - מושקי. הוא נפתח עם אקורדים של אבטיח, פירות יער אדומים עסיסיים והדרים. הלב מקיף פרחים של יסמין כוכב, פקעות וורדים מוחלטים. השביל הסופי מורכב מחמאה אוריס, אלגום ומוסק. עיצוב הבקבוק זהה לזו של הבכורה, הפעם מועשר בצבע ורוד בהיר, אשר קים הכריזה כאובססיה החדשה שלה. הניחוח זמין כ-30, 50 ו-100 מ"ל או דה פרפום. גלאם הושק בשנת 2012. מוצר זה מיוצר בארה"ב.

أطلقت كيم كارداشيان الأمريكية الشهيرة التليفزيونية الواقعية عطرها الجديد المسمى غلام، وهو الوسيلة الثالثة لعطر كيم كارداشيان الأصلي (الاثنين الآخر يشملان جولد اند لاف). جلام هو عطر برائحة الزهور والفواكه مع خلفية من الخشب البودرة - المسك. يبدأ العطر بمزيج من البطيخ والتوت الأحمر والحمضيات. يحتوي القلب على زهور من الياسمين النجمي ومسك الروم الدرني والورد. يتكون المسار النهائي من زبدة السوسن وخشب الصندل والمسك. تصميم الزجاجة هو نفسه لأول مرة، هذه المرة غنية باللون الوردي الزاهي، الذي أعلنت كيم بأنها شغفها الجديد. يتوفر العطر بحجم 30 و50 و100 مل. تم إطلاق جلام في عام 2012. صُنع هذا المنتج في الولايات المتحدة الأمريكية.

Kim Kardashian lançou seu novo perfume chamado Glam, que é o terceiro flanker da fragrância original Kim Kardashian (as outras duas incluem ouro e amor). O glamour é uma fragrância floral – frutada com amadeirada em pó – fundo almiscarado. Ele abre com acordos de melancia, frutas vermelhas suculentas e cítricas. O coração engloba flores de jasmim, tuberose e rosa absoluta. A trilha final consiste de manteiga de Orris, sândalo e almíscar. O design da garrafa é o mesmo que para a estreia, desta vez enriquecido com cor rosa brilhante, que Kim proclamou como sua nova obsessão. A fragrância está disponível como 30, 50 e 100 ml de Eau de Parfum. Glam foi lançado em 2012. Este produto é fabricado nos EUA.

美國噴氣機與真人電視名人金卡黛珊推出了名為 Glam的新香水,這是原始金卡黛珊香味的第三款調酒器(另外兩者包括黃金和愛)。 Glam 是一種花卉 - 水果香味,帶有粉狀木質 - 麝香背景。 它打開時有西瓜、多汁的紅漿果和柑橘。 心形包含星星茉莉花、紫紅和玫瑰的花朵。 最後一步由奧里斯黃油、檀香和麝香組成。 瓶子設計與首次亮相相同,這次又富含亮粉色,Kim 宣稱她的新執意。 香味有 30、50 和 100 毫升香水可供選擇。 Glam 於 2012 年推出。 本產品在美國製造。

description:
Title: 4 ounce Genuine Ogallala Bay Rum REGULAR STRENGTH Cologne. Comes in a cobalt blue bottle.

Description: 4 ounce Genuine Ogallala Bay Rum Cologne comes in a cobalt blue old-time looking bottle and label. The bottle itself would make a great bathroom decoration...but you'll definitely want to use the product too. Genuine Ogallala Bay Rum products have a bold, refreshing fragrance...like you remember from years ago in the barber shop. It has much more fragrance than most...it smells like Bay Rum used to. The cologne is our premium product. THIS IS THE REGULAR STRENGTH VERSION. The cologne comes with an additional label on the tag that reads: "Warning! Contents are potent. Not for sissies." Comes with a card that reads: From 1870-1885 Ogallala was the destination of countless cowboys driving cattle north from Texas to the railhead. It's a sure bet that as the boys hit town one of their first stops was a barbershop for a bath, shave and a haircut. After being splashed (quite generously) with the barber's own special mix of Bay Rum, he was ready to hit the saloon and talk to the young ladies who were anxious to sell him drinks. While we can't do much about the dance hall girls we can bring back that great old fashioned fragrance - Bay Rum! Genuine Ogallala Bay Rum is simply the best you'll find! A final note on this product. Never judge a cologne (any of em...not just ours) by the way it smells in the bottle. There are variables involved. How it smells on you after a little while is one of em. Another in our particular case is that several guys have noted that it seems to "mellow" on them after a few minutes and takes on a totally different aroma than what they sniff when they remove the cap.

bullet_point: [In 1380, the father prior of the Carthusian Monastery of St. Giacomo was taken unaware by the news of the arrival of the Queen Giovanna D'Angio to Capri, and so made a flower arrangement with the most beautiful flowers of the island., The water was not changed for three days and, when the flowers were thrown away, the prior noticed that the water acquired a fragrance unknown to him. title: Paloma Picasso Eau De Parfum Spray For Women, 3.4 Ounce
bullet_point: [The fragrance opens with a fresh and spicy note of coriander, angelica and carnation., This a fragrant self-portrait., This perfume is an elegant floral chypre]
description:
The perfume created by Paloma Picasso - the daughter of the famous painter. This a fragrant self-portrait. Her maternal grandfather was a perfumer, so, as a child, she was familiar with combining smells, creating scents. Her artistic talent is something she inherited from her father, therefore she was very successful in her work as a jewelry designer for Yves Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co. Her favorite perfume is Chanel Nº 5, so she wanted to create a perfume with an aldehydic accord. Red is her favorite color and black is a symbol of power. This perfume is an elegant floral chypre with a Mediterranian temperament, but because the perfume was very complex, it was very hard to market. She was afraid that her associates would change the formula, but luckily, this didn’t happen. The fragrance opens with a fresh and spicy note of coriander, angelica and carnation. Aldehydes are in harmony with ylang ylang, jasmine and hyacinth. Woody notes of oakmoss, patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver, and tobacco blend with original animal notes (castoreum, civet, and musk).

El perfume creado por Paloma Picasso - la hija del famoso pintor. Este es un autorretrato fragante. Su abuelo materno era perfumista, por lo que, cuando era niño, estaba familiarizada con combinar olores, creando aromas. Su talento artístico es algo que heredó de su padre, por lo que tuvo mucho éxito en su trabajo como diseñador de joyas para Yves Saint Laurent y Tiffany & Co. Su perfume favorito es Chanel Nº 5, por lo que quería crear un perfume con un acuerdo aldehídico. El rojo es su color favorito y el negro es un símbolo de poder. Este perfume es un elegante chipre floral con un temperamento mediterráneo, pero debido a que el perfume era muy complejo, era muy difícil de comercializar. Tenía miedo de que sus asociados cambiaran la fórmula, pero afortunadamente, esto no sucedió. La fragancia se abre con una nota fresca y picante de cilantro, angélica y clavel. Aldehídos están en armonía con ylang ylang, jazmín y jacinto. Notas amaderadas de musgo de roble, pachulí, sándalo, vetiver y tabaco se mezclan con notas animales originales (castóreo, civet y almizcle).

Das Parfüm, das von Paloma Picasso kreiert wurde - der Tochter des berühmten Malers. Dies ist ein duftendes Selbstporträt. Ihr mütterlicher Großvater war Parfümeur, also war sie als Kind vertraut, Gerüche zu kombinieren und Düfte zu erzeugen. Ihr künstlerisches Talent ist etwas, das sie von ihrem Vater geerbt hat, daher war sie sehr erfolgreich in ihrer Arbeit als Schmuckdesigner für Yves Saint Laurent und Tiffany & Co. Ihr Lieblingsparfüm ist Chanel Nº 5, also wollte sie ein Parfüm mit einem aldehydischen Einklang kreieren. Rot ist ihre Lieblingsfarbe und Schwarz ist ein Symbol der Macht. Dieses Parfüm ist ein eleganter blumiger Chypre mit mediterranem Temperament, aber weil das Parfüm sehr komplex war, war es sehr schwer zu vermarkten. Sie hatte Angst, dass ihre Mitarbeiter die Formel ändern würden, aber zum Glück passierte dies nicht. Der Duft öffnet sich mit einer frischen und würzigen Note von Koriander, Angelica und Nelke. Aldehyde sind im Einklang mit Ylang-Ylang, Jasmin und Hyazinthe. Holzige Noten von Eichenmoos, Patchouli, Sandelholz, Vetiver und Tabak Mischung mit originellen Tiernoten (Ciborum, Zivet und Moschus).

العطر الذي ابتكره بالوما بيكاسو - ابنة الرسام الشهيرة. هذه صورة ذاتية عطرية. كان جدها الأم صانع عطر، لذا كطفل كانت على دراية بجمع الروائح مما يخلق الروائح. موهبتها الفنية هي شيء ترثه من والدها، لذلك كانت ناجحة للغاية في عملها كمصمم مجوهرات لإيف سان لوران وتيفاني آند كو. عطرها المفضل هو شانيل رقم 5، لذلك أرادت صنع عطر مع مزيج الألدهيد. الأحمر هو لونها المفضل والأسود هو رمز السلطة. هذا العطر هو قبرصي زهور أنيق مع مزاج البحر المتوسط، ولكن بسبب كان العطر معقدًا للغاية، كان من الصعب جدًا تسويقه. كانت خائفة من أن زملائها سيغيرون التركيبة، ولكن لحسن الحظ لم يحدث ذلك. يبدأ العطر برائحة منعشة ولاذعة من الكزبرة والانجليكا والقرنفل. تتناغم الألدهيدات مع الإيلانج والياسمين والياسمين. مزيج الروائح الخشبية من طحلب السنديان والباتشولي وخشب الصندل ونجيل الهند والتبغ مع روائح الحيوانات الأصلية (الكاستوريوم والزباد والمسك).

O perfume criado por Paloma Picasso – a filha do famoso pintor. Este é um auto-retrato perfumado. Seu avô materno era um perfumista, então, quando criança, ela estava familiarizada com a combinação de cheiros, criando perfumes. Seu talento artístico é algo que ela herdou de seu pai, portanto ela foi muito bem-sucedida em seu trabalho como designer de joias para Yves Saint Laurent e Tiffany & Co. Seu perfume favorito é Chanel Nº 5, então ela queria criar um perfume com um acorde aldeídico. O vermelho é sua cor favorita e o preto é um símbolo de poder. Este perfume é um chipre floral elegante com um temperamento mediterrânico, mas como o perfume era muito complexo, era muito difícil de comercializar. Ela tinha medo de que seus parceiros mudassem a fórmula, mas, felizmente, isso não aconteceu. A fragrância abre com uma nota fresca e picante de coentro, angélica e cravo. Os aldeídos estão em harmonia com ylang ylang, jasmim e jacinto. Notas amadeiradas de musgo de carvalho, patchouli, sândalo, vetivo e tabaco se misturam com notas originais de animais (castóreo, civet e almíscar).

由 Paloma Picasso 創作的香水 - 著名畫家的女兒。 這是一款芬芳的自拍照。 她的祖父是一名香水,所以在孩子時,她熟悉結合氣味,創造香味。 她的藝術才華是她從父親那裡繼承的東西,因此她在 Yves Saint Laurent 和 Tiffany & Co. 的一名珠寶設計師中非常成功。 她最喜歡的香水是 Chanel Nº 5,所以她想要創造一款具有甲醛的香水。 紅色是她最喜歡的顏色,黑色是力量的象徵。 這款香水是一款優雅的花朵,帶有地中海風情,但由於香水非常複雜,因此很難上市。 她害怕她的同事會改變公式,但幸運的是,這並沒有發生。 香味打開時帶有香菜、天使和康乃馨的清新辛辣香調。 甲醛與依蘭、茉莉和風鈴相稱。 木本香調的橡苔、廣藿香、檀香、香根香根和菸草混合原始動物香調(蓖麻、香茅和麝香)。

由著名画家的女儿 Paloma Picasso 创作的香水。 这是一个芳香的自拍照。 她的孕妇祖父是一位香水,因此,作为孩子,她熟悉混合气味、产生香味。 她的艺术才华是她父亲继承的,因此她在作为 Yves Saint Laurent 和 Tiffany & Co. 珠宝设计师的作品中非常成功。 她最爱的香水 Chanel Nº 5,所以她想用醛调配来创造一种香水。 红色是她最喜欢的颜色,黑色是力量的象征。 这种香水是一种优雅的花卉胭脂红,具有地中海气质,但由于香水非常复杂,因此很难市场。 她害怕她的同事会改变公式,但幸运的是,这并没有发生。 香味打开时充满了香菜、天使和康乃馨的清香。 醛与依兰、茉莉和风信子相协调。 木香调的橡木、广藿香、檀香、香根草和烟草混合原动物香调(蓖麻、西猫和麝香)。

유명한 화가의 딸인 팔로마 피카소가 만든 향수입니다. 이것은 향기로운 자기 초상화입니다. 어머니의 할아버지는 조향사였기 때문에 어렸을 때 냄새를 결합하여 향기를 만드는 것에 익숙했습니다. 그녀의 예술적 재능은 아버지로부터 물려받은 것이기 때문에 Yves Saint Laurent와 Tiffany & Co.의 보석 디자이너로서 매우 성공적이었습니다. 그녀가 가장 좋아하는 향수는 샤넬 Nº 5이므로 알데히스틱으로 향수를 만들고 싶었습니다. 레드는 그녀가 가장 좋아하는 색상이며 검정색은 권력의 상징입니다. 이 향수는 지중해 기질을 가진 우아한 꽃 치프레이지만 향수는 매우 복잡하기 때문에 시장에 매우 어렵습니다. 그녀는 그녀의 동료들이 포뮬러를 바꿀 것을 두려워했지만 다행스럽게도 이런 일이 일어나지 않았습니다. 고수풀, 안젤리카, 카네이션의 신선하고 매운 노트로 향기가 열립니다. 알데히드는 일랑 일랑, 자스민 및 히아신스와 조화를 이룹니다. 오크모스, 파출리, 샌달우드, 베티버 및 토바코 우디 노트와 오리지널 애니멀 노트(카스토륨, 사향)가 혼합되어 있습니다.

title: BOSS The Scent Absolute for Him Eau de Parfum - Fragrance for Men, 3.3 FL. OZ.
description:
BOSS The Scent Absolute for Him offers a richer and more intense interpretation of the original BOSS The Scent masculine fragrance. Its signature ingredients – stimulating Ginger and exotic Maninka fruit – combine with the arousing power of Mondia roots and the elegance of Vetiver to create an absolutely seductive, absolutely addictive Eau de Parfum. Spicy, stimulating top notes of Ginger entice, pulling the senses irresistibly into the perfume’s aphrodisiac core: a hypnotic heart blending the addictive, rum-laced sweetness of the Maninka fruit with the sensuality of Mondia roots. Vetiver brings a smoky, virile elegance to the base note of the fragrance, as it dries down and lingers seductively on the skin. Composed by perfumer Bruno Jovanovic, BOSS The Scent Absolute for Him is a sophisticated and captivating Oriental Ambery fragrance. It is presented in a flacon crafted from heavy, faceted glass, set within a metal cage – to capture and contain the rich intensity of an absolutely addictive masculine Eau de Parfum.

BOSS The Scent Absolute for Él ofrece una interpretación más rica e intensa de la fragancia masculina BOSS The Scent original. Sus ingredientes exclusivos – estimulantes de jengibre y fruta exótica Maninka – se combinan con el poder de excitación de las raíces de Mondia y la elegancia de Vetiver para crear un Eau de Parfum absolutamente seductor y absolutamente adictivo. Las notas picantes y estimulantes del jengibre atraen, tirando de los sentidos irresistiblemente en el núcleo afrodisíaco del perfume: un corazón hipnótico que mezcla la dulzura adictiva y atada con ron de la fruta Maninka con la sensualidad de las raíces de Mondia. Vetiver aporta una elegancia ahumada y viril a la nota base de la fragancia, ya que se seca y permanece seductivamente en la piel. Compuesto por el perfumista Bruno Jovanovic, BOSS The Scent Absolute for Él es una fragancia sofisticada y cautivadora oriental Ambery. Se presenta en un flacon hecho de vidrio pesado y facetado, engastado dentro de una jaula de metal, para capturar y contener la rica intensidad de un Eau de Parfum masculino absolutamente adictivo.

BOSS The Scent Absolute for Him bietet eine reichhaltigere und intensivere Interpretation des ursprünglichen BOSS The Scent maskulinen Dufts. Seine charakteristischen Inhaltsstoffe - stimulierende Ingwer und exotische Maninka-Frucht - verbinden sich mit der anregenden Kraft der Mondia-Wurzeln und der Eleganz von Vetiver zu einem absolut verführerischen, absolut süchtig machenden Eau de Parfum. Würzige, anregende Kopfnoten von Ingwer verlockt und zieht die Sinne unwiderstehlich in den Aphrodisiakumkern des Parfüms: ein hypnotisches Herz, das die süchtig machende, rum-geschnitzte Süße der Maninka-Frucht mit der Sinnlichkeit der Mondia-Wurzeln vermischt. Vetiver bringt eine rauchige, virile Eleganz in die Basisnote des Duftes, da es trocknet und verführerisch auf der Haut verweilt. Hergestellt vom Parfümeur Bruno Jovanovic, BOSS The Scent Absolute for Him ist ein raffinierter und fesselnder orientalischer Bernsteinduft. Es präsentiert sich in einem Flakon aus schwerem, facettiertem Glas, eingefasst in einem Metallkäfig, um die reichhaltige Intensität eines absolut süchtig machenden maskulinen Eau de Parfum einzufangen und zu enthalten.

BOSS The Scent Absolute for Him מציע פרשנות עשירה ואינטנסיבית יותר לניחוח הגברי המקורי של BOSS The Scent. המרכיבים הייחודיים שלו – מעוררים ג'ינג'ר ופירות מנינקה אקזוטיים – בשילוב עם הכוח המעורר של שורשי מונדיה והאלגנטיות של Vetiver ליצירת בושם מפתה לחלוטין, ממכר לחלוטין. פיקנטי, מגרה את התווים העליונים של ג'ינג'ר מפתה, מושך את החושים באופן בלתי ניתן לעמוד בפניה לתוך ליבת הבושם: לב היפנוטי המשלב את המתיקות הממכרת עם שרוך הרום של פרי Maninka עם החושניות של שורשי מונדה. Vetiver מביא אלגנטיות מעושנת וויילית לתו הבסיסי של הניחוח, שכן הוא מתייבש ונשאר מפתה על העור. מורכב על ידי הבשם ברונו ג'ובנוביץ', BOSS The Scent Absolute בשבילו הוא ניחוח אמברי מזרחי מתוחכם ושובה לב. היא מוצגת בשמיכה המיוצרת מזכוכית כבדה, עם פנים, בתוך כלוב מתכת – כדי ללכוד ולהכיל את העוצמה העשירה של בושם גברי ממכר לחלוטין.

description:
Pizza is a departure even for Demeter, stretching the boundary of the concept of wearable fragrance. But we had to try - tomato sauce, creamy mozzarella, a touch of oregano - perfectly balanced for the adventurous. The history of Pizza, both the word and the food, is a murky and uncertain one. What is clear is Pizza, in one form or another, by one name or another, has been around for thousands of years, and will probably be around for thousands more. And now, Demeter has memorialized that fabulous scent, as well.

Pizza es una salida incluso para Demeter, estirando el límite del concepto de fragancia portátil. Pero tuvimos que probar - salsa de tomate, mozzarella cremosa, un toque de orégano - perfectamente equilibrado para los aventureros. La historia de la Pizza, tanto la palabra como la comida, es turbia e incierta. Lo que está claro es Pizza, de una forma u otra, por un nombre u otro, ha existido durante miles de años, y probablemente estará alrededor por miles más. Y ahora, Demeter también ha conmemorado ese fabuloso aroma.

Pizza ist auch für Demeter ein Abflug, der die Grenzen des Konzepts des tragbaren Duftes ausdehnt. Aber wir mussten versuchen: Tomatensauce, cremiges Mozzarella, ein Hauch Oregano - perfekt ausbalanciert für Abenteuerer. Die Geschichte von Pizza, sowohl das Wort als auch das Essen, ist ein trübes und ungewolltes Design. Was klar ist, ist Pizza in der einen oder anderen Form, mit dem einen oder anderen Namen, gibt es schon seit Tausenden von Jahren und wird wahrscheinlich schon seit Tausenden mehr sein. Und jetzt hat Demeter diesen fabelhaften Duft gedenkt.

A pizza é uma saída até mesmo para Demeter, esticando os limites do conceito de fragrância usável. Mas tivemos que experimentar – molho de tomate, mussarela cremosa, um toque de orégano – perfeitamente equilibrado para os aventureiros. A história da pizza, tanto a palavra quanto a comida, é escura e incerta. O que é claro é a pizza, de uma forma ou outra, de um nome ou outro, que está por aí há milhares de anos, e provavelmente estará por aí por milhares de mais. E agora, Demeter também memoriou aquele perfume fabuloso.

比萨饼对Demeter来说也是一种不二的，延伸了可穿戴香料概念的界限。 但我们必须尝试 - 番茄酱、奶油马苏里拉、一点牛至 - 完美平衡,适合冒险。 比萨的历史是一个泥泞和不确定的。 很清楚的是,披萨以一种或另一种形式存在,名字或另一种形式存在数千年,并且可能还存在数千年。 现在,Demeter 纪念了那种美妙的香味。

description:
In 2018, its new, modern version called L'Interdit Givenchy comes out, developed by perfumers Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo and Fanny Bal as a floral-woody composition. The perfume is built on the basis of contrast between a bouquet of white flowers (including jasmine, tuberose and orange blossom) and intense woody and earthy notes of patchouli and vetiver. The concept behind the creation is the "thrill of the forbidden" and the challenge of crossing the line.

En 2018 sale su nueva versión moderna llamada L'Interdit Givenchy, desarrollada por los perfumistas Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo y Fanny Bal como composición floral-leñosa. El perfume se construye sobre la base del contraste entre un ramo de flores blancas (incluyendo jazmín, tuberosa y azahar) y notas intensas de pachulí y vetiver. El concepto detrás de la creación es la "emoción de lo prohibido" y el reto de cruzar la línea.

בשנת 2018, הגרסה החדשה והמודרנית שלה הנקראת L'IntersXL ג'יבנשי יוצאת, פותחה על ידי הבשמים דומיניק רופיון, אן פליפו ופאני בל כקומפוזיציה פרחונית-עץ. הבושם בנוי על בסיס הניגוד בין זר פרחים לבנים (כולל יסמין, פקעות ופריחת תפוז) ותושבות עץ עז וארצי של פצ'ולי וטיבר. הרעיון מאחורי היצירה הוא "הריגוש של האסורים" והאתגר של חציית הקו.

Im Jahr 2018 kommt seine neue, moderne Version namens L'Interdit Givenchy heraus, entwickelt von Parfümeuren Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo und Fanny Bal als floral-holzige Komposition. Das Parfüm basiert auf der Grundlage des Kontrastes zwischen einem Bouquet aus weißen Blüten (einschließlich Jasmin, Tuberose und Orangenblüte) und intensiven holzigen und erdigen Noten von Patchouli und Vetiver. Das Konzept hinter der Kreation ist der "Nervenkitzel des Verbotenen" und die Herausforderung, die Linie zu überqueren.

Em 2018, sua nova versão moderna chamada L'Interdit Givenchy, desenvolvida pelos perfumistas Dominique Ropion, Anne Flipo e Fanny Bal como uma composição floral-amadeirada. O perfume é construído com base no contraste entre um buquê de flores brancas (incluindo jasmim, tuberose e flor de laranjeira) e notas intensas de patchouli e vetiver. O conceito por trás da criação é a "emoção do proibido" e o desafio de cruzar a linha.

2018 年,其新的现代版本称为L'Interdit Givenchy,由香水家 Dominique Ropion、Anne Flipo 和 Fanny Bal 开发,作为花卉木质成分。 香水是基于白色花束(包括茉莉花,晚香和橙花)和强烈的木香和朴素的朴素香调。 创作背后的概念是"禁忌的刺激"和跨越线的挑战。

2018 年,其名為 L'Interdit Givenchy 的新現代版本上市,由香水家 Dominique Ropion、Anne Flipo 和 Fanny Bal 作為花卉木質作品所開發。 這款香水是建立在一束白花 (包括茉莉花、紫檀和橙花) 與濃郁的木質和大地香調的相反之處。 創作背後的概念是「被禁者的快感」和跨越線的挑戰。

2018년, L'Interdit Givenchy라고 불리는 새로운 버전이 출시되어 조향사 도미니크 로피온, 앤 플리포 및 패니 발에 의해 플로럴우디 구성으로 개발되었습니다. 향수는 흰 꽃 부케(자스민, 튜베로스, 오렌지 꽃 포함)와 파출리와 베티베르의 강렬한 우디와 흙빛 노트를 기준으로 만들어집니다. 창조의 개념은 "금지된 자의 스릴"과 선을 넘기는 도전입니다.

title: Demeter Cologne Spray, Thunerstorm
bullet_point: [A thunderstorm brewing just over the next hill, you can `smell the rain, Demeter's thunderstorm reflecting the deep and violent nature of a summer storm, Layers well with a wide variety of scents including salt air, sweet orange, and coconut]
description: Have you ever considered the olfactory side of rain? You know it's coming, you can smell it in the air (exactly ). It does seem that on summer days when it is hot and dry, with a thunderstorm brewing just over the next hill, you can `smell the rain. Well, you can smell something, but rain? Have you ever tried to smell this same rain in January when the ground is frozen solid? Not a chance, but when the ground and plants are warmer, you can smell something. What you really smell comes not from the air, but the ground plants release oils that enter the soil and blend with the other earthy odors. These odors are released into the air when the relative humidity at ground level exceeds 75 percent. Moist humid air will transmit odors far better than dry air. In these moist humid conditions we notice these odors more readily. And since rain is so often connected with moist humid air, we tend to associate one with the other. The Demeter fragrance thunderstorm captures this complex sensory moment perfectly. Like poetry, thunderstorm is subtle and difficult to define, but real, with thunderstorm reflecting the deep and violent nature of a summer storm.

Starting a personal care company on a few thousand dollars, in a log cabin on a dirt road with no internet and a questionable phone line, could be classified as crazy. We wanted to create personal care products that are both healthy and have minimal environmental impact. We believe small changes in our everyday routine, like switching a can of aerosol shave cream to a recyclable tube of organic shave cream, can collectively have a long-term dramatic benefit to human health and the environment. title: Nautica Voyage by Nautica Eau de Toilette Spray for Men, 3.4 Ounce, Multicolor
bullet_point: [Nautica Voyage is a fresh and salty sea breeze,that carries romantic scents of coastal herbs and woods, Top Notes are Green leaves, Apple, Lotus, There is a tender dewy mimose in the heart, which is blended with watery note of lotus and an interesting accord of linen sail of a yacht, Base Notes are of Cedarwood, Marine notes, Amber, Musk, Keeps you fresh, confident for all day and night as it's a long lasting fresh aquatic scent]
description:
Nautica Voyage is a fresh and salty sea breeze,that carries romantic scents of coastal herbs and woods, and awakes the man's instinct to measure his power with wild nature. This is a fragrance for an active and romantic man who lives by his own rules. The face of the scent is TV host Caster Oosterhouse, a truly romantic person and a good nautician.
The composition opens with cold, green notes of leaves and apple. There is a tender dewy mimose in the heart, which is blended with watery note of lotus and an interesting accord of linen sail of a yacht. The composition is laid on a woody base, combined of cedar, moss, musk and amber. The nose behind the perfume is Maurice Roucel. The fragrance was launched in 2006.

Nautica Voyage ist eine frische und salzige Meeresbrise, die romantische Düfte von Küsten-Kräutern und Hölzern trägt und den Instinkt des Mannes weckt, seine Kraft mit wilder Natur zu messen. Dies ist ein Duft für einen aktiven und romantischen Mann, der nach seinen eigenen Regeln lebt. Das Gesicht des Duftes ist TV-Gastgeber Caster Oosterhouse, eine wirklich romantische Person und eine gute Nautician.
Die Komposition öffnet sich mit kalten, grünen Noten von Blättern und Apfel. Im Herzen befindet sich eine zarte, taufrische Mimose, die mit wässriger Lotusnote und einem interessanten Akzent von Leinensegeln einer Yacht vermischt ist. Die Komposition ist auf eine holzige Basis gelegt, kombiniert aus Zeder, Moos, Moschus und Bernstein. Die Nase hinter dem Parfüm ist Maurice Roucel. Der Duft wurde 2006 auf den Markt gebracht.

Nautica Voyage היא רוח ים רעננה ומלוחה, הנושאת ניחוחות רומנטיים של עשבי תיבול ועצים בחוף, ומעירה את האינסטינקט של הגבר כדי למדוד את כוחו בטבע הפראי. זהו ניחוח לגבר פעיל ורומנטי שחי לפי החוקים שלו. פני הריח הם מארח הטלוויזיה Caster Oosterhouse, אדם רומנטי באמת ונאוטיקאי טוב.
ההרכב נפתח עם נגיעות ירוקות וקרות של עלים ותפוח. יש מימוזה רך טלול בלב, אשר מעורבב עם תו מימי של לוטוס ואקורד מעניין של מפרש פשתן של יאכטה. ההרכב מונח על בסיס עץ, בשילוב של ארז, אזוב, מושק וענבר. האף מאחורי הבושם הוא מוריס רוקל. הניחוח הושק בשנת 2006.

نوتيكا فوياج هو نسيم بحري منعش ومالح، يحمل روائح رومانسية من الأعشاب الساحلية والأخشاب، ويستيقظ غريزة الرجل لقياس قوته بطبيعته البرية. هذا عطر لرجل نشط ورومانسي يعيش وفقًا لقواعده الخاصة. وجه الرائحة هو مضيف تلفزيون كاستر اوسترهاوس، شخص رومانسي حقيقي وبحري جيد.
تبدأ التركيبة بروائح باردة وخضراء من الأوراق والتفاح. يوجد ميموز رطب رقيق في القلب، يتم مزجه مع نوتة مائية من اللوتس وتناسق مثير للاهتمام من شراعة الكتان لليخوت. يتم وضع التركيبة على قاعدة خشبية ممزوجة من الأرز والطحالب والمسك والعنبر. مصمم العطر هو موريس روسيل. تم إطلاق العطر في عام 2006.

Nautica Voyage é uma brisa marinha fresca e salgada, que traz aromas românticos de ervas e madeiras costeiras, e desperta o instinto do homem de medir seu poder com natureza selvagem. Esta é uma fragrância para um homem ativo e romântico que vive de acordo com suas próprias regras. O rosto do perfume é o apresentador de TV Caster Oosterhouse, uma pessoa verdadeiramente romântica e um bom nauticista.
A composição abre com notas frias e verdes de folhas e maçã. Há uma mimose refrescante no coração, que é misturada com uma nota aquosa de lótus e um interessante acordo de vela de linho de um iate. A composição é colocada sobre uma base amadeirada, combinada de cedro, musgo, almíscar e âmbar. O nariz atrás do perfume é Maurice Roucel. A fragrância foi lançada em 2006.

Nautica Voyage 是一种清新的咸的海风,散发着海岸草药和木材的浪漫香味,唤醒男人的本能,用野生大自然来衡量自己的力量。 这是一款适合依据自己的规则生活的活跃和浪漫的男士的香水。 香味的面貌是电视主持人 Caster Osterhouse ,一个真正浪漫的人和一个优秀的航海家。
成分打开时带有寒冷、绿色的叶子和苹果。 在心脏中添加了柔嫩的露水气息,混合了莲花和游艇的亚麻风帆的有趣元素。 成分放置在木质底座上,结合雪松、苔藓、麝香和琥珀。 香水背后的鼻子是 Maurice Roucel。 该香水于2006年推出

Nautica Voyage 是一款清新鹹的海風,帶有沿海草藥和木材的浪漫香味,並喚醒了男人在野外測量力量的本能。 這是一個充滿活力的浪漫男人,按照自己的規則生活。 ​ 氣味的面孔是電視主持人 Caster Oosterhouse,一個真正浪漫的人和一個良好的航海家。
該組合物打開時帶有冷綠的葉子和蘋果香。 有一個溫柔的露水模仿心臟,它結合了水份的蓮花和一個有趣的遊艇亞麻帆。 該作品奠定在木質底座上,結合雪松、青苔、麝香和琥珀。 香水背後的鼻子是 Maurice Roucel。 香氛於 2006 年推出。

Nautica Voyage는 해안 허브와 숲의 로맨틱한 향기를 담고 있는 신선하고 짠 바닷바람으로, 야생 자연으로 힘을 측정하기 위해 남성의 본능을 깨웁니다. 자신의 규칙에 따라 사는 활동적이고 로맨틱한 남성을 위한 향기입니다. 향기의 얼굴은 진정으로 로맨틱한 사람이자 좋은 해병사인 TV 호스트 캐스터 우스터하우스입니다.
잎과 사과의 차가운 녹색 노트로 구성이 열립니다. 심장에는 부드러운 이슬 같은 흉내가 있으며, 연꽃의 물 노트와 요트의 리넨 돛에 대한 흥미로운 협정이 혼합되어 있습니다. 삼나무, 이끼, 머스크 및 호박이 결합된 우디 베이스 위에 놓여 있습니다. 향수 뒤의 코는 모리스 루셀입니다. 향수는 2006년에 출시되었습니다.

Blazer by Anne Klein Cologne 4 oz Spray for Women
bullet_point: [Original Version, Discontinued, Cologne, 4 oz, Spray, Women, Boxed]
description: This is the ORIGINAL fragrance that was introduced by Anne Klein, USA in the early 1970’s. In or around 1974, Blazer was purchased by Helena Rubinstein, and they continued to produce the original version. Later on, they made changes to the formulation and packaging. The original Blazer by Anne Klein bottle has sharp, rectangular lines and a prominent lion logo. The newer Helena Rubinstein version bottle has rounder corners and the lion logo is gone. The fragrance is DISCONTINUED and hard to find. We are offering the original Blazer by Anne Klein.  Blazer is a most divine green aromatic that represents an almost ideal scent. It is clean and streamlined and seems perfectly balanced. Blazer starts out like a tonic, but juniper lavender and bergamot give it a crisp herbal and soapy start- which is followed by the clean green/white floral & spice heart. The finish is lightly green and woody. The top fragrance notes are juniper, bergamot and lavender- in addition, I smell lemon verbena, mint, clove, and especially in the base, patchouli, cedar and perhaps ambergris. The flowers are restrained and green. To my nose, geranium and marigold stand out. Blazer is a clean, crispy scent with the soapiness and whiteness of Chanel22, but pared down and less flowery. Anne Klein's streamlined tailored sensibility was not traditionally feminine and Blazer was a fairly masculine smelling perfume that fit her style of clothing. Blazer is easy to wear and still smells amazingly modern to me, making it a gem of 1970's perfumery; its balance of green masculine and white feminine notes would be appropriate for work or casual day wear today, as it was 40 years ago.

description:
Yves Rocher MOMENT de BONHEUR Eau de Parfum Limited Edition, 50 ml./1.7 fl.oz.

ROSE CENTIFOLIA

A very fine quality of raw material.

One of the most beautiful roses, the Rose Centifolia, is a flower of a hundred petals and a soft, subtle scent. It is grown in Grasse (the south of France) for Moment de Bonheur Yves Rocher.

It is also called the May Rose, for the month in which it is harvested.

It takes approximately 800 kg of flower to obtain 1 kg of Rose Centifolia absolute…

Its rarity and incomparable scent make it the most subtle rose used in perfumery.

Key botanicals: Rose Centifolia absolute and infusion, Geranium essential oil, Cedar wood essential oil, Patchouli essential oil.

HISTORY OF FRAGRANCE

"This fragrance is pure color, there is nothing dark about it."

Annick Menardo’s idea for this new Yves Rocher fragrance, a green floral, fresh and feminine with personality:

"This is a colorful fragrance with a burst of green and fresh head notes that reveal a floral heart around the Rose Centifolia from Grasse, one of the most beautiful qualities of rose. For this floral heart, I’ve used an absolute and an infusion of Rose Centifolia. Finally, the woody base with notes of Patchouli and Cedar add a vibrant effect that underscores the elegance of this fragrance."

description:
The House of Fragonard...a passionate dedication.

It was shortly before the First World War that Eugène Fuchs, an entrepreneur at heart who had already been seduced by the magic of perfume, decided to set up his own perfumery based on the novel concept of selling perfumery products directly to the tourists who were beginning to discover the French Rivera’s charms. Parfumerie Fragonard was opened in 1926. Eugène Fuchs chose to name it after the famous Grasse-born painter, Jean-Honoré Fragonard (1732-1806), as a tribute to both the town of Grasse and to the refinement of 18th-century arts. Similarly, the choice of name expressed his desire to run his business in accordance with traditions.

This spirit has been loyally perpetuated by the three succeeding generations who have run and are still running the company.

title: Roberto Cavalli Nero Assoluto Eau De Parfum, 2.5 Fl Oz
bullet_point: [All our fragrances are 100% originals by their original designers., This item is by designer Roberto Cavalli., Due to manufacturer packaging changes, product packaging may vary from image shown.]
description:
Nero Assoluto is a decidedly uncompromising creation : absolute quality, absolute sensuality, absolute glamour. An artful contrast of boldness and elegance, it perfectly reflects Roberto Cavalli’s values, his unique sense of style and audacity. It was especially designed for women who are not afraid to stand out and assert themselves. A sensual and exclusive bottle, an elegant and sophisticated scent, a refined lesson in the art of seduction. The night is still young, full of untold promises. In the velvet half-light of her room, she unveils a sinuous silhouette, baring the soft glow of her golden skin printed tiger gown. Her secret fragrance suddenly fills the air, adding to the incredible sensuality of this moment. Glamour, feminine, absolute. Its elegance is bestowed by its precious and ultimate quality key ingredients. A seductive orchestra of orchids, paves the way with a captivating top note that attracts attention and awakens the senses. This delicate but opulent flower bestows exceptional sensuality, that is prolonged and intensified by a rich and warm middle note of dark vanilla. The dualism of Nero Assoluto is highlighted by its bitter sweet aroma. This unique fragrance boasts a heady and majestic woody base note of ebony.

Nero Assoluto ist eine entschieden kompromisslose Kreation: absolute Qualität, absolute Sinnlichkeit, absoluter Glamour. Ein kunstvoller Kontrast von Kühnheit und Eleganz, spiegelt es perfekt Roberto Cavalli Werte wider, seinen einzigartigen Sinn für Stil und Kühnheit. Es wurde speziell für Frauen entwickelt, die keine Angst haben, herauszustechen und sich selbst durchzusetzen. Eine sinnliche und exklusive Flasche, ein eleganter und raffinierter Duft, eine raffinierte Lektion in der Kunst der Verführung. Die Nacht ist noch jung, voller unerzählter Versprechen. Im samtigen Halblicht ihres Zimmers enthüllt sie eine geschmeidige Silhouette, die den sanften Schein ihres goldenen Haut-gedruckten Tigerkleides entdeckt. Ihr geheimer Duft erfüllt plötzlich die Luft und trägt zur unglaublichen Sinnlichkeit dieses Moments bei. Glamour, feminin, absolut. Seine Eleganz wird durch seine wertvollen und ultimativen Inhaltsstoffe verliehen. Ein verführerisches Orchester der Orchideen, ebnet den Weg mit einer fesselnden Kopfnote, die Aufmerksamkeit auf sich zieht und die Sinne weckt. Diese zarte aber opulente Blume verleiht außergewöhnliche Sinnlichkeit, die durch eine reichhaltige und warme Herznote von dunkler Vanille verlängert und verstärkt wird. Der Dualismus von Nero Assoluto wird durch sein bitteres, süßes Aroma hervorgehoben. Dieser einzigartige Duft verfügt über eine berauschende und majestätische holzige Basisnote von Ebenholz.

Nero Assoluto é uma criação decididamente intransigente: qualidade absoluta, sensualidade absoluta, glamour absoluto. Um contraste artístico de ousadia e elegância, reflete perfeitamente os valores de Roberto Cavalli, seu senso único de estilo e audácia. Foi especialmente projetado para mulheres que não têm medo de se destacar e se afirmarem. Uma garrafa sensual e exclusiva, um aroma elegante e sofisticado, uma lição refinada na arte da sedução. A noite ainda é jovem, cheia de promessas não contadas. Na meia-luz de veludo do seu quarto, ela revela uma silhueta sinuosa, desvendando o brilho suave de seu vestido de tigre estampado com pele dourada. Sua fragrância secreta repentinamente enche o ar, adicionando a incrível sensualidade deste momento. Glamour, feminino, absoluto. Sua elegância é concedida por seus preciosos e ingredientes essenciais de melhor qualidade. Uma orquestra sedutora de orquídeas, abre o caminho com uma nota superior cativante que atrai a atenção e desperta os sentidos. Esta flor delicada mas opulenta proporciona sensualidade excepcional, que é prolongada e intensificada por uma nota média rica e quente de baunilha escura. O dualismo de Nero Assoluto é destacado pelo seu aroma amargo doce. Esta fragrância exclusiva apresenta uma nota de base amadeirada e majestosa de ébano.

Nero Assoluto 是一个绝对不妥协的创造:绝对质量、绝对性感、绝对魅力。 大胆和优雅的巧妙对比,完美体现了 Roberto Cavalli 的价值观、他独特的风格和谦逊感。 专为不惧脱颖而出和自主的女性设计。 一款性感而独特的奶瓶,优雅而精致的香味,精致的诱惑艺术课程。 夜晚仍然年轻,充满了未知的承诺。 在她的房间半光的天鹅绒里，她展现了松动的轮廓，展现了她金皮印花老虎礼服的柔软光泽。 她的秘密香水突然充斥着空气,增添了这一瞬间的魅力。 魅力四射,女人味十足。 其珍贵和终极品质的关键成分赋予其优雅气质。 一个诱人的兰花管弦乐,为吸引注意力和唤醒感官的迷人前调铺平了道路。 这种细腻而华丽的花具有非凡的性感性,通过浓郁温暖的中调的深色香草来延长和增强。 Nero Assoluto 的二元主义通过其苦味甜美的香气突出了其特点。 这种独特的香味具有一股雄伟的乌木基调。

title: Paradis Perdu Eau De Parfum Unisex
bullet_point: [parfumes]
description: 1889…Time stood still in the temporary glass palaces of the Paris World Fair. The pavilions, showing their iron lacework undersides, celebrated booming industry and Art Nouveau. It is against this thrilling backdrop that Frapin cognacs were rewarded for their excellence. Created with the vitality of Art Nouveau, Paradis Perdu is an ode to the vineyards around the Frapin estate. The perfumer, Amélie Bourgeois, drew her inspiration from the expanses of land, conjuring effervescence with curved lines, somewhere between gushing and encircling. A hint of sap is first to be noted, the new Eve in this Garden of Eden. It rises from the soil in a rustling of vetiver roots. Intertwined up the vine shoots, a sign of lasting freshness, the sap changes from crisp green to dark green. Basil, with its insolence as a new shoot, muddles the severe green of the large vine leaves. The bitter green of spinach leaves heralds the quirky elegance of this organic harmony. As in Art Nouveau, Amélie has distilled nature and guided it to abstraction. In line with this joyful art, she has skilfully played with exotic green notes, changing Paradisamide into Paradise. Paradis Perdu Notes Bergamot, Grapefruit, Citron, Yellow Mandarin, Leaf Blend (Basil, Spinach, Vine, Ravensara), Galbanum, Elemi, Paradisamide, Vetiver, Hay, Virginia Cedarwood, Rosewood, Labdanum, Precious Woods, Mosses, Musks

description:
The name itself is a nod to the West Indies legend of the “Princesses of Malabar.” It’s a hint to the story of a mythical kingdom of the “Malabar coast,” which included the famous Kerala forest. There, a peaceful and refined civilization developed for centuries under the gracious helm of the “Nair” reigning queens. They would thereafter be referred to as “Princesses of Malabar” and epitomize women’s political leadership in the eyes of 18th century philosophers.

“Princesses de Malabar,” a modern though very feminine perfume, is an original scent, long lasting and easy to wear. It’s mostly targeted at millenials, who will enjoy its joyful and sensual composition.

The base ring of the cap is golden, and the top is a mixture of pink and orange shades, like a precious coral from ashore the Malabar coast, or a hint to the bright and vivid colors of the Kerala forest tropical flowers.

description: In 200 ad, famous Greek physician Hippocrates, recommends sweet apples with meals as aids to digestion and sour apples only for fainting and constipation. Of course Hippocrates never had the advantage of tasting a sour apple lollipop. The origin of lollipops is widely disputed. There does not seem to be an answer that everyone agrees on, so it remains one of life's little mysteries. What is not mysterious is how they bring back childhood memories for almost all of us. Credit for mass production of lollipops is contested by Wisconsin and California, while the origin of the "candy on a stick" concept is even murkier.

description: Cabochard is a fragrant image of Alix Gres. Even the name, chosen by Madame Gres herself (in French Cabochard means 'stubborn' or 'headstrong') reflects her free spirit and will. Cabochard was created after Madame Gres' trip to India. She described a beautiful perfume to the young perfume creator Guy Robert � very flowery, rich like tuberose yet softer, contrasted by fresh, slightly green note. It was a water hyacinth! After several trials, Madame Gres recognized her perfume. It was light and floral. However, the trend dictated intensive and strong chypre (Tabac Blond (1919), Cuir de Russie (1924), Scandal (1933), Bandit (1944)), so Madame Gres decided to launch two perfumes at the same time: floral Chouda and leather chypre Cabochard, created by Bernard Chant with IFF.Cabochard was launched in 1959 and instantly became very popular; Madame Gres said that it reminded her of her walks along the long and empty beaches of India: sharp freshness of the morning air, warmth of sandalwood, a touch of flower and comfort of the sea breeze.A couple of months after it was created the production of Chouda was suspended. The delivered 5 liters of the perfume was most probably worn by Madame Gres herself.The first bottle of Cabochard was very plane and simple (Madame Gres wanted to minimize the costs), with pharmaceutical top and a grey bow. The Chouda bottle had a green bow.

title: Lacoste L’homme Intense Eau De Toilette, 3.3 oz
description:
L’Homme Lacoste Intense stands out with its winning temperament. Its tenacity and boldness are the keys to its success and charisma, the source of its distinctive seductive power. The top notes unite delicious quince and rhubarb, enhanced with a zest of mandarin and orange. At the heart of the fragrance, spices swirl together to form an intensely energetic cocktail: vibrant black pepper, ginger and jasmine burst forth, barely mellowed by a drizzle of almond. Here we find all the strength and vivacity that characterize the famous crocodile. The base notes team up power and masculinity. Dominant cedarwood and akigalawood notes take on a touch of exoticism brought by amber and vanilla. Vetiver and cypriol roots add an extra dose of intensity, body and seduction that make L’Homme Lacoste Intense an unique male fragrance.

L'Homme Lacoste Intense destaca por su temperamento ganador. Su tenacidad y audacia son las claves de su éxito y carisma, fuente de su poder seductor distintivo. Las notas superiores unen deliciosos membrillo y ruibarbo, realzado con una ralladura de mandarina y naranja. En el corazón de la fragancia, las especias se giran juntas para formar un cóctel intensamente enérgico: la pimienta negra vibrante, el jengibre y el jazmín estallan, apenas suavizado por una llovizna de almendra. Aquí encontramos toda la fuerza y vivacidad que caracterizan al famoso cocodrilo. Las notas de base combinan poder y masculinidad. Las notas dominantes de madera de cedro y akigalawood toman un toque de exotismo traído por el ámbar y la vainilla. Las raíces de vetiver y cipriol añaden una dosis extra de intensidad, cuerpo y seducción que hacen de L'Homme Lacoste Intense una fragancia masculina única.

L'Homme Lacoste Intense überzeugt mit seinem Siegertemperament. Seine Zähigkeit und Kühnheit sind die Schlüssel zum Erfolg und Ausstrahlung, die Quelle seiner unverwechselbaren verführerischen Kraft. Die Kopfnoten vereinen köstliche Quitte und Rhabarber, ergänzt mit einer Geschmacksnote von Mandarine und Orange. Im Herzen des Duftes verwirren Gewürze zu einem intensiv energetischen Cocktail: lebhafter schwarzer Pfeffer, Ingwer und Jasmin platzen heraus, kaum von einem Nieselregen Mandel gemildert. Hier finden wir die Stärke und Lebendigkeit, die das berühmte Krokodil auszeichnet. Die Basisnoten verbinden Kraft und Männlichkeit. Dominantes Zedernholz und Akigalaholznoten nehmen einen Hauch von Exotik hervor, der von Bernstein und Vanille hervorgerufen wird. Vetiver und Zyriolwurzeln fügen eine Extraportion Intensität, Körper und Verführung hinzu, die L'Homme Lacoste Intense zu einem einzigartigen männlichen Duft machen.

FAQ

What is a pocket cologne?

A pocket cologne is a small size cologne, contained in a robust non-glass container. This makes a pocket cologne suitable to carry in your pocket / purse, etc. Additionally, due to their small size, they are allowed on flights with almost all airlines around the world.

How do I use Snap?

Like any other perfume / cologne, pressing the spray pump on top will release the fragrance.

title: Demeter Cologne Spray, New Baby
bullet_point: [New baby is a light, bright, transparent and sheer fragrance, Slight lemony touches and an underlying creaminess, one of the most beautiful, and most complex, Layers well with a wide variety of scents including blue spruce, mistletoe, and pineapple]
description:
New baby is a light, bright, transparent and sheer fragrance, with slight lemony touches and an underlying creaminess. This is one of the most beautiful, and most complex, classic fragrances Demeter has ever produced. Despite its complexity, new baby is in the classic library because it is linear, meaning that it expresses its nature immediately and does not change over time. That means in addition to being beautiful in its own right, it will also add depth and complexity to many personal blends. New baby has been a white whale of Demeter fragrance library, a fragrance that took 15 years to bring to market. It is almost a relief to launch this fragrance, a concept that someone asks us for each and every week.

Nuevo bebé es una fragancia ligera, brillante, transparente y pura, con ligeros toques de limón y una cremosidad subyacente. Esta es una de las fragancias clásicas más bellas y complejas que Demeter ha producido. A pesar de su complejidad, el nuevo bebé está en la biblioteca clásica porque es lineal, lo que significa que expresa su naturaleza inmediatamente y no cambia con el tiempo. Eso significa además de ser hermoso por derecho propio, también agregará profundidad y complejidad a muchas mezclas personales. Nuevo bebé ha sido una ballena blanca de la biblioteca de fragancias Demeter, una fragancia que tomó 15 años para llevar al mercado. Es casi un alivio lanzar esta fragancia, un concepto que alguien nos pide cada semana.

Das neue Baby ist ein leichter, heller, transparenter und durchscheinender Duft, mit leichten zitronigen Noten und einer darunterliegenden Cremigkeit. Dies ist einer der schönsten und komplexesten und klassischen Düfte, die Demeter je produziert hat. Trotz seiner Komplexität befindet sich das Neugeborene in der klassischen Bibliothek, weil es linear ist, was bedeutet, dass es seine Natur sofort zum Ausdruck bringt und sich mit der Zeit nicht verändert. Das bedeutet, dass es nicht nur schön ist, sondern auch vielen persönlichen Mischungen Tiefe und Komplexität verleiht. Das neue Baby ist ein Weißwal der Demeter-Duftbibliothek, ein Duft, der 15 Jahre brauchte, um auf den Markt zu bringen. Es ist fast eine Erleichterung, diesen Duft zu starten, ein Konzept, das uns jemand jede Woche fragt.

התינוק החדש הוא ניחוח קל, בהיר, שקוף ושקוף, עם נגיעות לימוניות קלות וקרמיות בסיסית. זהו אחד הניחוחות היפים והמורכבים ביותר, הקלאסיים דמטר אי פעם ייצר. למרות המורכבות שלו, התינוק החדש נמצא בספרייה הקלאסית מכיוון שהוא ליניארי, כלומר הוא מבטא את טבעו באופן מיידי ולא משתנה עם הזמן. כלומר, בנוסף להיותו יפה בזכותו, הוא גם יוסיף עומק ומורכבות לתערובות אישיות רבות. תינוק חדש הוא לוויתן לבן של ספריית הניחוח של דמטר, ניחוח שלקח 15 שנה להביא לשוק. כמעט הקלה לשגר את הניחוח הזה, רעיון שמישהו שואל אותנו בכל שבוע.

O novo bebê é uma fragrância leve, brilhante, transparente e transparente, com pequenos toques de limão e uma cremosidade subjacente. Esta é uma das fragrâncias mais bonitas e mais complexas, clássicas que Demeter já produziu. Apesar de sua complexidade, o novo bebê está na biblioteca clássica porque é linear, o que significa que ele expressa sua natureza imediatamente e não muda com o tempo. Isso significa que, além de ser bonito por conta própria, também adicionará profundidade e complexidade a muitas misturas pessoais. O novo bebê tem sido uma baleia branca da biblioteca de fragrâncias Demeter, uma fragrância que levou 15 anos para trazer ao mercado. É quase um alívio lançar esta fragrância, um conceito que alguém nos pergunta a cada semana.

新生婴儿是一种轻便、明亮、透明、透明的清香,带有轻微的柠檬味和底层乳膏。 这是Demeter有史以来生产的最美丽、最复杂的经典香水之一。 尽管它很复杂,但新宝宝在经典图书馆中,因为它是线性的,这意味着它立即表达了它的性质,并且不会随着时间的推移而变化。 这意味着除了自己的美感外,它还会为许多个人混合物增加深度和复杂性。 新生宝宝是 Demeter 香水库的白鲸,这一香水需要 15 年才能投入市场。 发起这种香味几乎是一种缓解方法,这是一个有人要求的概念。

The House of Fragonard...a passionate dedication.

It was shortly before the First World War that Eugène Fuchs, an entrepreneur at heart who had already been seduced by the magic of perfume, decided to set up his own perfumery based on the novel concept of selling perfumery products directly to the tourists who were beginning to discover the French Rivera’s charms. Parfumerie Fragonard was opened in 1926. Eugène Fuchs chose to name it after the famous Grasse-born painter, Jean-Honoré Fragonard (1732-1806), as a tribute to both the town of Grasse and to the refinement of 18th-century arts. Similarly, the choice of name expressed his desire to run his business in accordance with traditions.

This spirit has been loyally perpetuated by the three succeeding generations who have run and are still running the company.

description:
New Bond St. is the new fragrance from Bond No 9, available from mid-September 2018. "Here at Bond No. 9, we’ve always loved the low-key, unassuming, out-of-the-way NoHo side street that’s been our headquarters and flagship since 1999. Today, this two-block cobblestoned stretch is no longer unassuming. Sure, it still exudes a vintage Downtown vibe. But dramatic changes have taken place on Bond Street. Over the past several years, it’s evolved into a zone of casually elegant fabulousness for the millennial supermodels, the iconic movie stars, the politicos and business tycoons who’ve moved into the minimalist starchitect condos now punctuating Bond Street. Not to mention the paparazzi and bloggers who follow in their wake and the savvy young shoppers frequenting the indie boutiques and A-list destination restaurants that’ve sprung up as if by magic."

New Bond St. ist der neue Duft von Bond No 9, erhältlich ab Mitte September 2018. "Here at Bond No. 9. Wir lieben die zurückhaltende, unscheinbare NoHo-Seitenstraße, die seit 1999 unser Hauptsitz und Flaggschiff ist. Heute ist dieser Zweiblock Cobblestoned Stretch nicht mehr unnachahmlich. Sicher, es strahlt immer noch eine Vintage-Downtown-Atmosphäre aus. Aber dramatische Veränderungen haben auf der Bond Street stattgegeben. In den vergangenen Jahren entwickelte sie sich zu einer Zone der lässig-eleganten Fabelhaftigkeit für die tausendjährigen Supermodels, die ikonischen Filmstars, die Politios und Business-Tycoons, die sich in die minimalistischen Starchitekt-Hütten umzogen haben, die jetzt Bond Street durchzeichnen. Ganz zu schweigen von Paparazzi und Bloggern, die in ihrem Gehalt folgen, und die versierten jungen Käufer häufig die Indie-Boutiquen und A-Listenz-Zielrestaurants besuchen, die wie von Zauberhand aufgekommen sind."

뉴본드 세인트는 본드 넘버 9의 새로운 향기입니다. 2018년 9월 중순부터 구매 가능합니다. "Here at Bond No. 9, 우리는 항상 1999년부터 본사와 주력이었던 로우 키, 추정하지 않은 노호 사이드 스트리트를 사랑했습니다. 오늘날, 이 투블록 조약돌 스트레치는 더 이상 추정하지 않습니다. 물론, 여전히 빈티지 시내 분위기를 발산합니다. 그러나 본드 스트리트에서 극적인 변화가 일어났습니다. 지난 몇 년 동안 이 제품은 밀레니엄 슈퍼모델, 상징적인 영화 배우, 정치 및 비즈니스 거물을 위해 캐주얼하고 우아한 멋진 영역으로 진화했습니다. 이제 본드 스트리트를 강조하는 미니멀리스트 스타키텍 콘도로 옮겼습니다. 깨어난 파파라치와 블로거와 정통한 젊은 쇼핑객들이 마치 마법처럼 튀어나온 인디 부티크와 A-리스트 목적지 레스토랑을 자주 하는 것은 말할 것도 없습니다
