title: Paloma Picasso Eau De Parfum Spray For Women, 3.4 Ounce
bullet_point: [The fragrance opens with a fresh and spicy note of coriander, angelica and carnation., This a fragrant self-portrait., This perfume is an elegant floral chypre]
description:
The perfume created by Paloma Picasso - the daughter of the famous painter. This a fragrant self-portrait. Her maternal grandfather was a perfumer, so, as a child, she was familiar with combining smells, creating scents. Her artistic talent is something she inherited from her father, therefore she was very successful in her work as a jewelry designer for Yves Saint Laurent and Tiffany & Co. Her favorite perfume is Chanel Nº 5, so she wanted to create a perfume with an aldehydic accord. Red is her favorite color and black is a symbol of power. This perfume is an elegant floral chypre with a Mediterranian temperament, but because the perfume was very complex, it was very hard to market. She was afraid that her associates would change the formula, but luckily, this didn’t happen. The fragrance opens with a fresh and spicy note of coriander, angelica and carnation. Aldehydes are in harmony with ylang ylang, jasmine and hyacinth. Woody notes of oakmoss, patchouli, sandalwood, vetiver, and tobacco blend with original animal notes (castoreum, civet, and musk).

El perfume creado por Paloma Picasso - la hija del famoso pintor. Este es un autorretrato fragante. Su abuelo materno era perfumista, por lo que, cuando era niño, estaba familiarizada con combinar olores, creando aromas. Su talento artístico es algo que heredó de su padre, por lo que tuvo mucho éxito en su trabajo como diseñador de joyas para Yves Saint Laurent y Tiffany & Co. Su perfume favorito es Chanel Nº 5, por lo que quería crear un perfume con un acuerdo aldehídico. El rojo es su color favorito y el negro es un símbolo de poder. Este perfume es un elegante chipre floral con un temperamento mediterráneo, pero debido a que el perfume era muy complejo, era muy difícil de comercializar. Tenía miedo de que sus asociados cambiaran la fórmula, pero afortunadamente, esto no sucedió. La fragancia se abre con una nota fresca y picante de cilantro, angélica y clavel. Aldehídos están en armonía con ylang ylang, jazmín y jacinto. Notas amaderadas de musgo de roble, pachulí, sándalo, vetiver y tabaco se mezclan con notas animales originales (castóreo, civet y almizcle).

Das Parfüm, das von Paloma Picasso kreiert wurde - der Tochter des berühmten Malers. Dies ist ein duftendes Selbstporträt. Ihr mütterlicher Großvater war Parfümeur, also war sie als Kind vertraut, Gerüche zu kombinieren und Düfte zu erzeugen. Ihr künstlerisches Talent ist etwas, das sie von ihrem Vater geerbt hat, daher war sie sehr erfolgreich in ihrer Arbeit als Schmuckdesigner für Yves Saint Laurent und Tiffany & Co. Ihr Lieblingsparfüm ist Chanel Nº 5, also wollte sie ein Parfüm mit einem aldehydischen Einklang kreieren. Rot ist ihre Lieblingsfarbe und Schwarz ist ein Symbol der Macht. Dieses Parfüm ist ein eleganter blumiger Chypre mit mediterranem Temperament, aber weil das Parfüm sehr komplex war, war es sehr schwer zu vermarkten. Sie hatte Angst, dass ihre Mitarbeiter die Formel ändern würden, aber zum Glück passierte dies nicht. Der Duft öffnet sich mit einer frischen und würzigen Note von Koriander, Angelica und Nelke. Aldehyde sind im Einklang mit Ylang-Ylang, Jasmin und Hyazinthe. Holzige Noten von Eichenmoos, Patchouli, Sandelholz, Vetiver und Tabak Mischung mit originellen Tiernoten (Ciborum, Zivet und Moschus).

O perfume criado por Paloma Picasso – a filha do famoso pintor. Este é um auto-retrato perfumado. Seu avô materno era um perfumista, então, quando criança, ela estava familiarizada com a combinação de cheiros, criando perfumes. Seu talento artístico é algo que ela herdou de seu pai, portanto ela foi muito bem-sucedida em seu trabalho como designer de joias para Yves Saint Laurent e Tiffany & Co. Seu perfume favorito é Chanel Nº 5, então ela queria criar um perfume com um acorde aldeídico. O vermelho é sua cor favorita e o preto é um símbolo de poder. Este perfume é um chipre floral elegante com um temperamento mediterrânico, mas como o perfume era muito complexo, era muito difícil de comercializar. Ela tinha medo de que seus parceiros mudassem a fórmula, mas, felizmente, isso não aconteceu. A fragrância abre com uma nota fresca e picante de coentro, angélica e cravo. She did not want her fragrance to be overpowering, but instantly recognizable, like infamous aromatic concoction she made for herself from 3 separate fragrances before she co-created Lovely. Lovely is a soft, powdery, discrete and very intimate fragrance, announced as 'silky white amber'. It possesses an elegance characteristic of classic fragrances. And yet the fragrance is quite modern and very charming. It opens with soft citruses (nectarine and bergamot) and woody (rosewood) notes, with a touch of lavender, which is very discrete and not at all sharp. The fragrance develops further with notes of apple martini, white daffodil and orchid. The base unites white amber, cedar, woody notes and white musk. According to Sarah's words, the perfume is appropriate for all generations: 'from 17 to 107'. The fragrance was created by Laurent Le Guernec and Clement Gavarry in 2005 with Sarah herself being the creative director, actively participating in the process from its start to finish. This product is manufactured in France.

CACHAREL Anais Anais PREMIER DELICE EAU DE TOILETTE 30ML VAPO.
bullet_point: [Women's Fragrance, ml size perfect for travelling, Floral fragrance for women, Fragrance released in 2014]
description:
On se souvient du parfum phare Anaïs Anaïs de la maison Cacharel. Ce doux parfum connu de beaucoup de femmes, Anaïs Anaïs, fut  l'un des parfums les plus célèbres et les plus porté au monde depuis la date de sa création en 1978 par la maison Cacharel. Son nom s'inspire d'Anaïtis, la déesse orientale de l'amour des perses et des arméniens.

Aujourd'hui, La maison Cacharel revisite son parfum iconique Anais-Anais. Conçu comme le précédent, pour les jeunes filles, entre l'adolescence et l'âge adulte, il s'adresse à celle qui se sentent libre et délicieusement fleurie. Anaïs Anaïs Premier Délice est une fragrance beaucoup plus legère que la précèdente. On retrouve des notes floral avec un mélange de belles fleurs, envoûtantes et romantique.

"Nous avons inventé une nouvelle gourmandise pour parler de romantisme aux jeunes filles, avec un accord moderne et naturel de poire et de cacao", commence Dora Arnaud, le premier nez de Cacharel. "Mais la signature de la marque reste identifiable grâce aux notes florales toujours présentes dans la nouvelle fragrance", complète le deuxième parfumeur, Olivier Cresp.En ce sens, le nom du parfum réinterprété, Premier Délice, fait écho à la découverte du corps à l'aube d'une adolescence toujours plus précoce.

A l'occasion de la sortie du tout nouveau parfum Anaïs Anaïs Premier délice de Cacharel, les créateurs du parfum ont investi le Palais de Tokyo à Paris, pour une soirée très girly.

description:
Inspired by the trench coat and its heritage of British design and craftsmanship, My Burberry captures the fragrance of a London garden after the rain. The scent is a contemporary British grand floral and features a delicate heart of rose, woven with an unexpected touch of geranium leaf.

Inspirado en la gabardina y su herencia de diseño y artesanía británicos, My Burberry captura la fragancia de un jardín de Londres después de la lluvia. El aroma es un gran floral británico contemporáneo y cuenta con un delicado corazón de rosa, tejido con un toque inesperado de hoja de geranio.

Inspiriert vom Trenchcoat und seinem Erbe britischer Designs und Handwerkskunst fängt My Burberry den Duft eines Londoner Gartens nach dem Regen ein. Der Duft ist ein zeitgenössisches, britisches Blumenmuster und verfügt über ein zartes Herz aus Rose, gewebt mit einem unerwarteten Hauch von Geranienblatt.

בהשראת מעיל הגשם והמורשת של העיצוב הבריטי והאומנות שלו, My Burberry לוכדת את הניחוח של גן לונדון אחרי הגשם. הריח הוא פרחוני גדול בריטי עכשווי וכולל לב עדין של ורד, ארוג עם נגיעה בלתי צפויה של עלה גרניום.

مستوحاة من معطف المطر وتراثها من التصميم والحرفية البريطانية، تجسد ماي بيربري رائحة حديقة لندن بعد المطر. هذه الرائحة هي زهور بريطانية كبيرة عصرية وتتميز بقلب رقيق من الورد، منسوجة بلمسة غير متوقعة من أوراق الغرنوقي.

Inspirado pelo trench coat e sua herança de design e artesanato britânicos, My Burberry captura a fragrância de um jardim de Londres após a chuva. O aroma é um grande floral britânico contemporâneo e apresenta um delicado coração de rosa, tecido com um toque inesperado de folha de gerânio.

My Burberry 靈感來自風衣及其英國設計和工藝傳統,在雨後捕捉了倫敦花園的香味。 香味是一種當代英國盛大的花卉,並以精緻的玫瑰心,以意想不到的天竺葵葉編織而成。

description:
VII Rock Rose is a perfume composed of 202 precious ingredients, and its complex and intriguing blend offers a modern interpretation of classic leather fougère. Distilled from the juice of a hundred taracco oranges, the top of this fragrance also combines bergamot oil and black pepper to create a rich masculine warmth for an invigoring blend of citrus oils. The warm and aromatic fragrance of rock rose takes you back to the coveted English gardens in the era of Queen Anne. Lavender and clary sage offer a clean edge to create crisp contrast at the heart. As one of the rarest elements on earth, befitting the title "red gold," saffron's vivid crimson pigment mirrors the intense suede-like warmth that is infused into the unique base of this fragrance. Inspired by horticultural, architectural, and artistic movements throughout English history, Noble VII is a eulogy to the beauty of a Queen Anne garden. This unisex fragrance was created with VII Cosmos Flower to offer unique definitions of a similar concept.

VII Rock Rose es un perfume compuesto por 202 ingredientes preciosos, y su compleja e intrigante mezcla ofrece una interpretación moderna de la clásica fougère. Destilada del jugo de cien naranjas de taracco, la parte superior de esta fragancia también combina aceite de bergamota y pimienta negra para crear una rica calidez masculina para una mezcla estimulante de aceites cítricos. La fragancia cálida y aromática de la rosa roca te lleva de vuelta a los codiciados jardines ingleses en la era de la reina Ana. La lavanda y la salvia clara ofrecen un borde limpio para crear un contraste nítido en el corazón. Como uno de los elementos más raros de la tierra, acorde con el título "oro rojo", el pigmento carmesí vívido del azafrán refleja el intenso calor parecido al ante que se infunde en la base única de esta fragancia. description:
XXI Vanilla Orchid is composed of 157 precious ingredients, and this green floriental perfume is fresh and modern to suit any wearer, and the energetic scent is brimming with joy — making it ideal for daily use. The top notes open to the evocative touch of sharp galbanum and crisp hyacinth — an intensely green and intoxicating white floral, which is heady yet softened by the powdery scent of spring. This warm heart contrasts beautifully with an explosion of florals. Green and sweet with a hint of lemon and spice, muguet opens up and freshens other floral notes to balance the bouquet. The scent evolves into a sweet rum or treacle-like base, highlighted by mood-boosting vanilla, which is harvested by hand annually. It blends with sandalwood, musk, and smoky vetiver for warmth. Noble XXI perfumes exude decadence, energy, and confidence. Exquisite ingredients are blended in an exciting and intricately complex structure to create a utterly unique perfumes. This unisex fragrance was created with XXI Cypress to offer unique definitions of a similar concept.

XXI Vanilla Orchid se compone de 157 ingredientes preciosos, y este perfume floriental verde es fresco y moderno para adaptarse a cualquier usuario, y el aroma energético está lleno de alegría, lo que lo hace ideal para el uso diario. Las notas superiores se abren al toque evocador de galbano agudo y jacinto crujiente — un floral blanco intensamente verde e intoxicante, que es embriagador pero suavizado por el aroma polvoriento de la primavera. Este cálido corazón contrasta maravillosamente con una explosión de florales. Verde y dulce con un toque de limón y especias, muguet se abre y refresca otras notas florales para equilibrar el ramo. El aroma se convierte en un ron dulce o base similar a la melaza, destacado por la vainilla que aumenta el estado de ánimo, que se cosecha a mano anualmente. Se mezcla con sándalo, almizcle y vetiver ahumado para calidez. Nobles perfumes XXI exudan decadencia, energía y confianza. Los ingredientes exquisitos se mezclan en una estructura emocionante e intrincadamente compleja para crear un perfume totalmente único. Esta fragancia unisex fue creada con XXI Cypress para ofrecer definiciones únicas de un concepto similar.

bullet_point: [Mr. Burberry is an original product by Burberry., Packaging for this product may vary from that shown in the image above., This item is not for sale in Catalina Island.]
description:
Mr. Burberry. A man of contrasts. Classic yet contemporary; sophisticated and sensual. A sartorial elegance with a rebellious attitude. Authentic and British. London is his home, a city of subtlety and surprise. Like him, it is refined and elegant, not pristine or perfect. An energy and irreverence define their style. Mr. Burberry captures the essence of London and its moments, fusing classic scents of British perfumery with unexpected ingredients. Fresh and crafted top notes of crisp, zesty grapefruit, cut with a seductive base of earthy vetiver and smoky guaiac wood. The bottle is inspired by the iconic black Burberry trench coat, its quality, craftsmanship, style and timeless appeal. Celebrated for its innovative protective qualities and lauded for its versatility and durability. Bold and masculine, the weighted cap references horn-look buttons, while a hand-tied knot in English-woven black gabardine sits around the neck, celebrating the innovative fabric invented by Thomas Burberry more than 100 years ago.

מר בורברי. גבר של ניגודים. קלאסי אך עכשווי; מתוחכם וחושני. אלגנטיות מרדנית עם גישה מרדנית. אותנטי ובריטי. לונדון היא ביתו, עיר של עדינות והפתעה. כמוהו, הוא מעודן ואלגנטי, לא טהור או מושלם. אנרגיה ועצלות מגדירים את הסגנון שלהם. מר בורברי לוכד את המהות של לונדון ואת הרגעים שלה, משלב ניחוחות קלאסיים של בשמים בריטיים עם מרכיבים בלתי צפויים. ניחוחות עליונים רעננים ומעוצבים של אשכולית פריכה, נחתכות עם בסיס מפתה של vetiver אדמתית ועץ גואיאק מעושן. הבקבוק בהשראת מעיל הגשם האיקוני של Burberry שחור, האיכות, האומנות, הסגנון והמשיכה הנצחית. נחגג בשל איכויות ההגנה החדשניות שלו וזכה ברבגוניות ועמידותו. נועז וגברי, הכובע המשוקלל מתייחס ללחצנים במראה קרן, בעוד קשר קשור ביד בגברדין השחור הארוג האנגלי יושב סביב הצוואר, חוגג את הבד החדשני שהומצא על ידי תומס בורברי לפני יותר מ-100 שנה.

مستر بيربري. رجل من التناقضات. كلاسيكي وعصري وراقي ومثير. أناقة مميزة مع موقف متمرد. أصلي وبريطاني. لندن هي منزله، مدينة الخفية والمفاجأة. مثله ، إنه أنيق وأنيق ، ليس أصليًا أو مثاليًا. الطاقة والظهور تحدد أسلوبهم. يأسر مستر بيربري جوهر لندن ولحظاتها، حيث يمزج الروائح الكلاسيكية لعطور بريطانية بمكونات غير متوقعة. مكونات عليا منعشة ومصنوعة من الجريب فروت المنعش والقوي ومقصوصة بقاعدة مغرية من نجيل الهند وخشب الغاياك الدخاني. الزجاجة مستوحاة من معطف بيربري الأسود الأيقوني، الجودة والحرفية والأناقة وجاذبية دائمة. مشهور بخصائصه الواقية المبتكرة وأشاد بتنوع استخداماته ومتانته. جريء وذكوري، يشير الغطاء الثقيل إلى الأزرار ذات مظهر القرن، بينما عقدة مربوطة يدويًا في قماش الغبردان الأسود المنسوج باللغة الإنجليزية حول الرقبة، احتفالاً بالنسيج المبتكر الذي اخترعته توماس بيربري منذ أكثر من 100 عام.

Burberry 先生。 一個對比的人。 經典而現代;精緻而性感。 具有叛逆態度的服飾優雅。 正宗和英國。 London 是他的家,一個充滿微妙和驚喜的城市。 和他一樣,它精緻優雅,不是原始或完美。 能量和不敬決定了他們的風格。 Burberry 先生捕捉了倫敦的精髓及其時刻,將英國香水的經典香味與意想不到的成分融合在一起。 清新而精緻的前調,香脆、華麗的葡萄柚,以誘人的泥土香根和煙燻的瓜亞克木製成。 這款水瓶的靈感來自標誌性的黑色 Burberry 風衣,其品質、工藝、風格和永恆的吸引力。 以其創新的保護品質而聞名,並因其多功能性和耐用性而備受讚譽。 ​ 大膽而陽剛,加重帽參考了喇叭形鈕扣,而英國編織黑色頭巾的手工編織結在脖子上,慶祝 100 多年前由 Thomas Burberry 發明的創新布料。

버버리 씨. 대조를 이루는 남자. 클래식하면서도 현대적인; 정교하고 관능적입니다. 반항적인 태도를 가진 사토리얼 우아함. 정품 및 영국. 런던은 그의 집, 미묘함과 놀라움의 도시입니다. 그와 마찬가지로, 세련되고 우아하며 자연스럽거나 완벽하지 않습니다. 에너지와 불순함이 스타일을 정의합니다. 버버리 씨는 런던의 본질과 그 순간을 포착하여 영국 향수의 고전적인 향기와 예상치 못한 재료를 융합했습니다. 산뜻하고 풍미가 있는 자몽의 신선한 탑 노트는 흙의 베티버와 스모키 과아이악 목재의 매혹적인 베이스로 자릅니다. 이 병은 상징적인 블랙 버버버리 트렌치 코트의 품질, 장인 정신, 스타일 및 유행을 타지 않는 매력에서 영감을 얻었습니다. 혁신적인 보호 품질로 유명하며 다재다능함과 내구성으로 찬사를 받았습니다. 대담하고 남성적인 무게의 캡은 뿔 모양의 버튼을 참조하며, 영어로 짜여진 블랙 개버딘의 손으로 묶은 매듭이 목 주위에 위치하여 100년 전 Thomas Burberry가 발명한 혁신적인 원단을 기념합니다.

description: Historiae Perfume of History In 2012, Pascale Oger was living in a 17th century home called "The Kings Falconry", in the Versailles Plain, when she was working for L'Oreal. This scenery inspired the basis for her new luxury perfume line to tell the history of France with scents: Historiae, Perfume of History. This line is 100% made in France, and is the perfect embodiment of the know-how, creativity and culture of the French throughout history. Each item has its own perfume creator and designer, who specializes in international luxury brands, that makes each scent its own unique creation. Only one year after its debut, Historiae was awarded 1st place for "Primo Exportatuer" (or "Best Exporter") in 2013 by the Paris Chamber of Commerce. Hameau de la Reine A most delightful aroma inspired by Marie Antoinette's Hameau, also called "The Queen's Hamlet." This little village was built specifically for Ms. Antoinette herself, as a retreat for her and her 4 children, so they may enjoy the pleasures of the French countryside. The hamlet has its own meadowland with exhilarating lakes, streams, a farmhouse, mill wheel and is loaded with the most beautifully fragrant flowers and shrubs. This scenery is a direct inspiration for this home fragrance. Even just a trace of this scent will make you feel as though you are sitting with Marie herself, watching the kids play, and enjoying every moment of the awe inspiring beauty that is Hameau de la Reine. With combined floral scents of tulip, water jasmine, narcissus and rose; you will rest assured that she will be pleased, and might even thank you twice!

Deshalb ist es keine Überraschung, dass ihre modischen Düfte zu ihren Kreationen passen – natürlich und raffiniert, chic und sportlich, modern und feminin, sexy und glamourös. תווים מעץ של מסורת ambrox מעוררת את המסורת, בעוד הדרים מעודנים - ברגמוט ואשכולית, נותנים מודרניות. רמזים מימיים מוסיפים רעננות מרעננת. מעטפות של פלפל שחור, עץ פפירוס וקטורת מעניקים לגבריות, ויוצרים את הלב הפועם של הניחוח. הבסיס מודגש בשילוב של מושק מינרלי מפתה, שעועית Tonka וזעפרן - נזכר באינדיבידואליות של גבר. בראשות המעצב והפרובוקטיבי ביותר בעולם האופנה, Versace הוא שם נרדף באופן מוצדק לסגנון הגבוה האולטימטיבי. אז זה לא מפתיע שהניחוחות האופנתיים שלהם מתאימים ליצירות המסלול שלהם - טבעיים ומעודנים, שיקיים וספורטיביים, מודרניים ונשיים, סקסיים וזוהרים. מאז הצגת הניחוח הייחודי הראשון של ורסאצ'ה בשנת 1981, התווית האיטלקית החדשנית ממשיכה לייצר מוצרים המאפשרים לכולם ללבוש את הסמלים הרבים של אורח החיים ורסאצ'ה: יוקרה, זוהר וחושני.

This floral-woody perfume is an encounter of consciously sourced ingredients from around the globe. Bergamot meets orange blossom from Egypt in a luminous, sparkling start, with an amplified bright floral bouquet of tuberose and the soft scent of jasmine from India as the beating heart. The blue is the universal color that unites all of us. It is encircled by a golden ring, stamped with the Giorgio Armani signature, a symbol of a unique path that is illuminated by every encounter along the way.

Finalmente, una vibrante madera de cedro de Virginia se encuentra con un sensual aroma de vainilla de Madagascar y almizcle blanco para firmar la composición. La gorra azul y tono dorado es una metáfora visual para el mundo. El azul es el color universal que nos une a todos. Está rodeado por un anillo dorado, estampado con la firma Giorgio Armani, símbolo de un camino único que se ilumina por cada encuentro en el camino.

Schließlich trifft ein lebendiges Zedernholz von Virginia auf einen sinnlichen Vanilleduft aus Madagaskar und weißen Moschus, um die Komposition zu unterzeichnen. Die blaue und goldfarbene Kappe ist eine visuelle Metapher für die Welt. Das Blau ist die universelle Farbe, die uns alle vereint. Es ist umgeben von einem goldenen Ring, gestempelt mit der Signatur Giorgio Armani, ein Symbol für einen einzigartigen Weg, der von jeder Begegnung auf dem Weg beleuchtet wird.

Este perfume floral amadeirado é um encontro de ingredientes de origem consciente de todo o mundo. A bergamota encontra a flor de laranjeira do Egito em um começo luminoso e brilhante, com um buquê floral brilhante amplificado de tuberose e o aroma suave do jasmim da Índia como o coração batenda. Finalmente, um cedro vibrante da Virginia encontra um aroma sensual de baunilha de Madagascar e almíscar branco para assinar a composição. O boné azul e dourado é uma metáfora visual para o mundo. Coach Eau de Parfum is inspired by the spontaneous energy and chic downtown style of New York City. A fragrance full of contrasts, opening with bright, sparkling raspberry, giving way to creamy Turkish roses, before drying down to a sensual suede musk base. The feminine oval bottle references many of Coach's iconic codes. Its spray cap is shaped like a gold turnlock, imitating the signature clasp on Coach bags. Ebony and polished metal hangtags add a distinctive finishing touch. A horse and carriage logo, an enduring symbol of Coach craftsmanship, is subtly engraved into the glass. A nod to femininity, the soft pink packaging features a pebble leather effect as a tribute to the original American leather brand.

La botella ovalada femenina hace referencia a muchos de los códigos icónicos del Coach. Su tapa pulverizadora tiene forma de un giro dorado, imitando el cierre de la firma en las bolsas Coach. Ébano y metal pulido hangtags añaden un toque final distintivo. Un logotipo de caballo y carruaje, un símbolo duradero de la artesanía Coach, está sutilmente grabado en el cristal. description:
XX Water Lily is a sophisticated chypre perfume inspired by Art Nouveau's delicate floral shapes to leave a lingering impression that also evokes a smoothness reminiscent of the art's characteristic S shapes. Notes of sparkling aldehydes and green leaf add effervescence at the top to replicate the elegance of popping a crisp bottle of fine champagne for a citric, bubbly effect. The exquisite floral heart notes add a delicate smoothness from sumptuous water lilies that soften the heady hit of woodiness with its wistful, powdery scent. This complex base blends warm and amorous cashmere musk with mysterious patchouli for a sweet yet earthy aroma with hints of adventurous vetiver to ground the scent in a dry, leathery smokiness. Natural ingredients and fresh notes flourish throughout the Noble XX fragrances, which delight in the sensuous freedom of movement and celebrate organic forms that epitomised the Art Nouveau movement. This unisex fragrance was created with XX Papyrus to offer unique definitions of a similar concept.

XX Water Lily es un sofisticado perfume de chipre inspirado en las delicadas formas florales del Art Nouveau para dejar una impresión persistente que también evoca una suavidad que recuerda a las características de las formas S del arte. Notas de aldehídos espumosos y hojas verdes añaden efervescencia en la parte superior para replicar la elegancia de hacer estallar una botella crujiente de champán fino para un efecto cítrico y burbujeante. Las exquisitas notas florales de corazón añaden una delicada suavidad de suntuosos lirios de agua que suavizan el embriagador golpe de la leñosidad con su aroma cremoso y polvoriento. Esta base compleja combina almizcle de cachemira cálido y amoroso con pachulí misterioso para un aroma dulce pero terroso con toques de vetiver aventurero para moler el aroma en un ahumado seco y curioso. Los ingredientes naturales y las notas frescas florecen a lo largo de las fragancias Noble XX, que se deleitan con la libertad sensual de movimiento y celebran formas orgánicas que personifican el movimiento Art Nouveau. Esta fragancia unisex fue creada con XX Papyrus para ofrecer definiciones únicas de un concepto similar.

XX Water Lily הוא בושם צ'יפר מתוחכם בהשראת הצורות הפרחוניות העדינות של ארט נובו כדי להשאיר רושם מתמשך שגם מעורר חלקות המזכירה את צורות ה- S האופייניות של האמנות. הערות של אלדהידים נוצצים ועלים ירוקים מוסיפות קסם בחלק העליון כדי לשכפל את האלגנטיות של בקבוק פריך של שמפניה משובחת לקבלת אפקט לימון, מבעבע. תווי הלב הפרחוניים המעודנים מוסיפים חלקות עדינה מחבצלות מים מפוארות שמרככות את הלהיט העשיר של העץ עם הניחוח המגובב והאבקתי שלו. בסיס מורכב זה משלב מושק קשמיר חם ומאוהב עם פצ'ולי מסתורי לניחוח מתוק אך ארצי עם רמזים של וטיבר הרפתקני כדי לקרקע את הריח בעישון יבש ועור. מרכיבים טבעיים ותווים רעננים פורחים לאורך כל הניחוחות Noble XX, אשר מענגים את חופש התנועה החושני וחוגגים צורות אורגניות שהתגלמות בתנועת ארט נובו. ניחוח יוניסקס זה נוצר עם XX פפירוס כדי להציע הגדרות ייחודיות של קונספט דומה.

XX Water Lily ist ein anspruchsvolles Chypre-Parfüm, inspiriert von den zarten floralen Formen des Jugendstils und hinterlässt einen bleibenden Eindruck, der auch eine Glätte erinnert, die an die charakteristischen S-Formen der Kunst erinnert. Noten von funkelnden Aldehyden und grünem Blatt fügen Brause an der Spitze hinzu, um die Eleganz zu replizieren, eine knackige Flasche feinen Champagner für einen zitrischen, sprudelnden Effekt. Die exquisiten blumigen Herznoten fügen eine zarte Geschmeidigkeit von üppigen Seerosen hinzu, die den berauschenden Hit von Holzlichkeit mit ihrem wistrigen, pudrigen Duft erweichen. Diese komplexe Basis verbindet warmen und amourösen Kaschmir-Moschus mit geheimnisvollem Patchouli für ein süßes, aber erdiges Aroma mit einem Hauch von abenteuerlichem Vetiver, um den Duft in einer trockenen, lederigen Rauchheit zu erden. Natürliche Inhaltsstoffe und frische Noten gedeihen in den Noble XX Duftnoten, die die sinnliche Bewegungsfreiheit erfreuen und organische Formen feiern, die die Jugendstil-Bewegung verkörpern. Dieser Unisex-Duft wurde mit XX Papyrus kreiert, um einzigartige Definitionen eines ähnlichen Konzepts zu bieten.

XX Water Lily é um sofisticado perfume de chipre inspirado nas delicadas formas florais de Art Nouveau para deixar uma impressão persistente que também evoca uma suavidade reminiscente das características das formas S da arte. Notas de aldeído brilhante e folha verde adicionam efervescência na parte superior para replicar a elegância de estourar uma garrafa de champanhe fino para um efeito cítrico e borbulhante. As requintadas notas florais de coração adicionam uma suavidade delicada de nenúfios de água suntuosos que suavizam o sucesso de madeira com o seu aroma nobre e em pó. Esta base complexa mistura almíscar de caxemira quente e amoroso com patchouli misterioso para um aroma doce mas terroso com notas de vetiver aventureiro para aterrar o aroma em uma fumaça seca e de couro. Ingredientes naturais e notas frescas florescem em todas as fragrâncias Noble XX, que encantam a liberdade sensual de movimento e celebram formas orgânicas que epitomizam o movimento Art Nouveau. Esta fragrância unissex foi criada com XX Papyrus para oferecer definições únicas de um conceito semelhante.

XX Water Lily 是一款精緻的 chypre 香水,靈感來自新藝術主義的精緻花卉形狀,留下一種揮之不去的印象,也讓人聯想到藝術特性 S 形的光滑度。 閃耀的甲醛和綠色葉子的香調在頂部增加泡香,重現出一瓶清脆的精美香檳的優雅,帶來檸檬酸、氣泡效果。 精緻的花卉心形香調為奢華的水百合增添了精緻的光滑度,以其飄逸的粉末香味軟化了木質的令人愉悅的打擊。 這款複雜的底座融合了溫暖和美味的喀什米爾麝香和神秘的廣藿香,帶來甜美而泥土的香氣,以及一些冒險香根,以乾燥、皮革的煙熏為基底。 Noble XX 香味中含有天然成分和清新香調,享受感官的行動自由,並慶祝體現新藝術運動的有機形式。 這款中性香氛採用 XX 莎草紙製成,提供類似概念的獨特定義。

XX Water Lily 是一款精致的 chypre 香水,灵感源自新艺术主义的精致花卉形状,留下一种挥之不去的印象,也唤起人们联想到该艺术特色 S 形的光滑度。 闪亮的醛和绿叶的气味在顶部增加了泡腾,复制了一瓶清爽的香槟酒的优雅,以产生柠檬般的气泡效果。 精致的花卉心形香调增添了细腻的光滑度，散发着浓郁的粉末香味，软化木材的头号风情。 这款复杂基底融合了温暖和热情的羊绒麝香和神秘广藿香,营造甜美而朴实的香气,香根草在干燥的皮革烟中磨制香味。 天然成分和清香调在Noble XX 香水中散发出光彩,令人愉悦的运动自由,并庆祝体现新艺术运动的有机形式。 这款中性香水由 XX Papyrus 创造,提供类似概念的独特定义。

XX 워터 릴리는 아르누보의 섬세한 꽃 모양에서 영감을 얻은 정교한 치프레 향수로, 예술의 특징적인 S 모양을 연상시키는 부드러움을 불러일으키는 오래 지속되는 인상을 남깁니다. 스파클링 알데히드와 녹색 잎이 상단에 발포를 추가하여 구연산과 거품 효과를 위해 선명한 샴페인 한 병을 터뜨리는 우아함을 재현합니다. 아름다운 꽃 하트 노트는 고급스러운 수련에서 섬세한 부드러움을 더하여 밀가루 향기로 우드니스의 강렬한 타격을 부드럽게 합니다. 이 복잡한 베이스는 따뜻하고 사랑스러운 캐시미어 머스크와 신비한 파출리와 혼합되어 달콤하면서도 흙같은 향을 선사하며 모험적인 베티버의 힌트가 있어 건조하고 가죽 같은 스모키스로 향기를 갈아줍니다. 천연 성분과 신선한 노트는 Noble XX 향기에 번성하여 감각적인 움직임의 자유를 기쁘게 하고 아르누보 움직임을 대표하는 유기농 형태를 기념합니다. 이 유니섹스 향수는 XX 파피루스로 만들어져 비슷한 컨셉의 독특한 정의를 제공합니다.

Hergestellt mit Noten von rubinroter Grapefruit und Nashi-Birne, die mit Orangenblüte und Gardenie gemischt wird, ist es die Essenz der Weiblichkeit. Genießen Sie die Herznoten von Veilchen und Meeresbrise mit einer Basisschicht aus Patchouli, die Sie von Eleganz und Anmut umarmt. Die Flaschen werden durch einen einzigartigen Prozess entwickelt, der das Eintauchen von Hand umfasst, um ein Farbverlaufs-Finish zu erreichen, das das schicke und luxuriöse Gefühl der Marke Catherine Malandrino unterstreicht. Die schwere, metallische Stahlkappe mit eingraviertem "CM"-Schriftzug verleiht einen geometrischen Kontrast zur Weiblichkeit der Flasche - verkörpert die Ästhetik von Catherine Malandrino.

Feito com notas de toranja vermelha rubi e pera nashi misturando com flor de laranja e gardênia, é a essência da feminilidade. Desfrute de notas médias de violeta e brisa do oceano com uma camada base de patchouli seca que deixará você abraçado em elegância e graça. As garrafas são desenvolvidas através de um processo exclusivo que inclui mergulho à mão para alcançar um acabamento gradiente que acentua a sensação chique e luxuosa da marca Catherine Malandrino. A tampa de aço pesada, metálica com letras "cm" gravadas dá um contraste geométrico com a feminilidade da garrafa, incorporando a estética Catherine Malandrino.

采用红宝石葡萄柚和纳什梨混合橙花和栀子花,是女性气质的精髓。 享受紫罗兰和海风的中调,加上广藿香干燥层,让您优雅优雅。 瓶子采用独特的工艺,包括手工浸渍,以实现渐变饰面,突出Catherine Malandrino 品牌的别致和奢华感。 重金属质感的钢帽带有刻有"CM"字母,形成了一种几何对比,体现了Catherine Malandrino的美学。

MARITIME JOURNEY evoca la frescura fresca de una brisa marina y el poder energizante de las olas. Manzana limpia y espumosa y un corazón aromático reflejan la frescura enérgica de las olas que se estrellan que se seca en una base amaderada masculina y tranquilizadora.

MARITIME JOURNEY erinnert an die knackige Frische einer Meeresbrise und die energetisierende Kraft der Wellen. Sauberer, funkelnder Apfel und ein aromatisches Herz spiegeln die Frische der abfallenden Wellen wider, die zu einer beruhigenden, maskulinen holzigen Basis trocknet.

MARITIME JOURNEY מעורר את הרעננות הפריכה של רוח הים ואת הכוח הממריץ של הגלים. תפוח נקי ונוצץ ולב ארומטי משקפים את הרעננות המהירה של הגלים המתנגשים המתייבשים לבסיס עץ מרגיע וגברי.

A Jornada Marítima evoca o frescor nítido de uma brisa do mar e o poder energizante das ondas. Maçã limpa e brilhante e um coração aromático espelham o frescor das ondas que se esmagam em uma base amadeirada masculina tranquilizante.

MARITIME JOURNEY 喚起了海風清新和海浪的能量。 乾淨、閃閃發光的蘋果和芳香的心鏡反映了衝擊波的清新,乾燥成令人安慰、陽剛的木質底座。

海洋旅程唤起了清新的海风和波浪的能量力。 干净、闪闪发光的苹果和芳香的心形反映了崩溃的波浪的清澈清度,干燥成一个令人安心的木基地。

MARITIME JOURNEY는 바닷바람의 선명한 신선함과 파도의 활력을 불어넣습니다. 깨끗하고 반짝이는 사과와 아로마 심장이 충돌하는 파도의 상쾌한 신선함을 반영하여 안심할 수 있는 남성적인 우디 베이스로 건조됩니다.

title: 007 Fragrances James bond 007 ocean royale, 1.6 Ounce
bullet_point: [Top notes: sea breeze accord, lime, aniseed, Mid notes: teak wood, orris, cedar wood, Base notes: Guaiac wood, sandalwood, Jamaican coffee accord, Fragrance family: woody water, Fresh, sophisticated, adventurous]
description:
The fresh ingredients found in Ocean Royale add an adventurous twist to the Bond portfolio. The sea-breeze accord carries us to far away destinations, and the top notes of lime, aniseed and bergamot create an energising essence as stimulating as crisp sea-water. This bracing combination of ingredients helps men prepare for the adventure that lies ahead, providing them with the confidence they need to succeed. Orris is used as a compelling and potent ingredient reflecting the dangerous sophistication that is associated with Bond's character. A rich sensuality is brought to life through refined Teak Wood that lies at the heart of the scent. The base notes further submerge us into Bond's unmistakably masculine world, conjured by an array of intense and resilient woods. Guaiac and Cedar Wood are complemented by Sandalwood, an added elegance which takes Ocean Royale to new heights. Luxurious Tonka Bean and Jamaican Coffee accords add the finishing touch to this solid, masculine base.

Los ingredientes frescos que se encuentran en Ocean Royale añaden un toque aventurero a la cartera Bond. El acuerdo de brisa marina nos lleva a destinos lejanos, y las notas superiores de cal, anís y bergamota crean una esencia energizante como estimulante como el agua de mar crujiente. Esta combinación de ingredientes ayuda a los hombres a prepararse para la aventura que está por delante, proporcionándoles la confianza que necesitan para tener éxito. Orris se utiliza como un ingrediente convincente y potente que refleja la peligrosa sofisticación que se asocia con el carácter de Bond. Una rica sensualidad cobra vida a través de la refinada madera de teca que se encuentra en el corazón del aroma. Las notas de base nos sumergen aún más en el mundo inconfundiblemente masculino de Bond, conjurado por una serie de bosques intensos y resistentes. Guaiac y madera de cedro se complementan con sándalo, una elegancia añadida que lleva Ocean Royale a nuevas alturas. Los lujosos acuerdos de tonka y café jamaicano añaden el toque final a esta sólida base masculina.

Die frischen Zutaten in Ocean Royale verleihen dem Bond-Portfolio eine abenteuerliche Note. Die Meeresbrise führt uns zu weit entfernten Zielen, und die Kopfnoten von Limette, Anis und Bergamotte schaffen eine energetisierende Essenz, die so stimulierend ist wie knackiges Meerwasser. Diese Kombination aus Zutaten hilft Männern, sich auf das Abenteuer vorzubereiten, das vor Ihnen liegt, und bietet ihnen das Selbstvertrauen, das sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein. Orris wird als überzeugender und wirksamer Inhaltsstoff verwendet, der die gefährliche Raffinesse widerspiegelt, die mit dem Charakter von Bond verbunden ist. Eine reiche Sinnlichkeit wird durch raffiniertes Teakholz, das im Herzen des Duftes liegt, zum Leben erweckt. Die Basisnoten untertauchen uns weiter in Bond's unverwechselbar maskuline Welt, die von einer Vielzahl von intensiven und widerstandsfähigen Hölzern verzaubert wird. Guajac und Zedernholz werden durch Sandelholz, eine zusätzliche Eleganz, die Ocean Royale auf neue Höhen bringt. Luxuriöse Tonkabohnen und Jamaikanischer Kaffee verleihen dieser soliden, maskulinen Basis den letzten Schliff.

Os ingredientes frescos encontrados no Ocean Royale adicionam um toque aventureiro ao portfólio Bond. O acordo de brisa marinha nos leva para destinos distantes, e as notas de topo de limão, anis e bergamota criam uma essência energizante como estimulante como água salgada crocante. Esta combinação de ingredientes ajuda os homens a se prepararem para a aventura que está à frente, proporcionando a eles a confiança que precisam para ter sucesso. Orris é usado como um ingrediente atraente e potente refletindo a sofisticação perigosa associada ao caráter de Bond. Uma rica sensualidade é trazida à vida através da refinada madeira de teca que fica no coração do aroma. As notas de base nos submergem ainda mais no mundo inconfundível masculino de Bond, conjurado por uma variedade de madeiras intensas e resilientes. description:
The pink colored bottle announces softer and more luminous fragrance in comparison with Crystal Noir. Nowadays popular fruity note gives the composition slightly gourmand nuance. The top notes are pomegranate, Yuzu and frosted accord. Peony and magnolia are in the center of the composition, while waterly fresh lotus note moderates the intensity and sweetness of the floral accords. The opulent base introduces amber note extracted from plants, musk and red woods. The fragrance was designed by Alberto Morillas in 2006.

Die pinkfarbene Flasche bietet einen weicheren und strahlenderen Duft im Vergleich zu Crystal Noir. Heutzutage verleiht beliebte fruchtige Note der Komposition leicht Gourmand-Nuance. Die Kopfnoten sind Granatapfel, Yuzu und gefrosteter Akkord. Pfingstrose und Magnolie stehen in der Mitte der Zusammensetzung, während wässrig frische Lotusnote die Intensität und Süße der blumigen Akkorde moderiert. Die opulente Basis führt Bernsteinnote aus Pflanzen, Moschus und roten Hölzern heraus. Der Duft wurde 2006 von Alberto Morillas entworfen.

הבקבוק הוורוד מכריז על ניחוח רך וזוהר יותר בהשוואה ל-Crystal Noir. פתק פירותי פופולרי כיום נותן את ההרכב מעט ניואנס גורמה. התווים העליונים הם רימון, Yuzu ותאום מזוגג. אדמונית ומגנוליה נמצאים במרכז הרכב, בעוד שתו הלוטוס הרענן במים מתונה את העוצמה והמתיקות של הפרחים האישיים. הבסיס המפואר מציג פתק ענבר המופק מצמחים, מושק ועצים אדומים. הניחוח עוצב על ידי אלברטו מורילאס בשנת 2006.

الزجاجة ذات اللون الوردي تُعلن عن عطر أكثر نعومة وإشراقًا مقارنةً بكريستال نوير. في الوقت الحاضر تعطي رائحة الفواكه الشائعة التركيبة فارقًا طفيفًا في الغوامة. الروائح الأولية هي الرمان واليوزو والبلود. الفاوانيا والماغنوليا في مركز التركيبة، في حين أن رائحة اللوتس الطازجة المائية تقلل من كثافة وحلاوة الروائح الزهرية. تقدم القاعدة الفاخرة رائحة العنبر المستخلصة من النباتات والمسك والأخشاب الحمراء. تم تصميم العطر بواسطة ألبيرتو موريلاس في عام 2006.

A base opulenta introduz nota âmbar extraída de plantas, almíscar e madeiras vermelhas. A fragrância foi projetada por Alberto Morillas em 2006.

description: Cabochard is a fragrant image of Alix Gres. Even the name, chosen by Madame Gres herself (in French Cabochard means 'stubborn' or 'headstrong') reflects her free spirit and will. Cabochard was created after Madame Gres' trip to India. She described a beautiful perfume to the young perfume creator Guy Robert � very flowery, rich like tuberose yet softer, contrasted by fresh, slightly green note. It was a water hyacinth! After several trials, Madame Gres recognized her perfume. It was light and floral. However, the trend dictated intensive and strong chypre (Tabac Blond (1919), Cuir de Russie (1924), Scandal (1933), Bandit (1944)), so Madame Gres decided to launch two perfumes at the same time: floral Chouda and leather chypre Cabochard, created by Bernard Chant with IFF.Cabochard was launched in 1959 and instantly became very popular; Madame Gres said that it reminded her of her walks along the long and empty beaches of India: sharp freshness of the morning air, warmth of sandalwood, a touch of flower and comfort of the sea breeze.A couple of months after it was created the production of Chouda was suspended. The delivered 5 liters of the perfume was most probably worn by Madame Gres herself.The first bottle of Cabochard was very plane and simple (Madame Gres wanted to minimize the costs), with pharmaceutical top and a grey bow. The Chouda bottle had a green bow.

Charm and elegance are best when they come naturally and effortlessly. But for special moments we want to bring forward and enrich our best attributes. Reminiscent of tropical fruits, the note is bright and playful, and then returns elegantly with a sophisticated heart of violet leaf absolute and jasmine, radiating an effortless femininity. In a nod to the duality of sweetness and sensuality dear to the Lacoste woman, the vanilla accord and patchouli finish the scent with a magnetic intensity.

El encanto y la elegancia son mejores cuando vienen de forma natural y sin esfuerzo. Pero para momentos especiales queremos adelantar y enriquecer nuestros mejores atributos. Con reminiscencia de frutas tropicales, la nota es brillante y lúdica, y luego vuelve elegantemente con un sofisticado corazón de hoja violeta absoluta y jazmín, irradiando una feminidad sin esfuerzo. In Anlehnung an die Dualität von Süße und Sinnlichkeit, die der Lacoste-Frau liebe, vervollständigen die Vanilleakkord und Patchouli den Duft mit einer magnetischen Intensität.

description: Cabochard is a fragrant image of Alix Gres. Even the name, chosen by Madame Gres herself (in French Cabochard means 'stubborn' or 'headstrong') reflects her free spirit and will. Cabochard was created after Madame Gres' trip to India. She described a beautiful perfume to the young perfume creator Guy Robert � very flowery, rich like tuberose yet softer, contrasted by fresh, slightly green note. It was a water hyacinth! After several trials, Madame Gres recognized her perfume. It was light and floral. However, the trend dictated intensive and strong chypre (Tabac Blond (1919), Cuir de Russie (1924), Scandal (1933), Bandit (1944)), so Madame Gres decided to launch two perfumes at the same time: floral Chouda and leather chypre Cabochard, created by Bernard Chant with IFF.Cabochard was launched in 1959 and instantly became very popular; Madame Gres said that it reminded her of her walks along the long and empty beaches of India: sharp freshness of the morning air, warmth of sandalwood, a touch of flower and comfort of the sea breeze.A couple of months after it was created the production of Chouda was suspended. The delivered 5 liters of the perfume was most probably worn by Madame Gres herself.The first bottle of Cabochard was very plane and simple (Madame Gres wanted to minimize the costs), with pharmaceutical top and a grey bow. The Chouda bottle had a green bow.

description:
Yves Rocher Comme Une Evidence Intense Eau De Parfum, 50 ml./1.7 fl.oz.

FLORAL CHYPRE INDULGENT

A floral heart built around two signature natural raw materials of Comme un Evidence: Damascus rose essential oil and jasmine absolute.

Damascus rose essential oil: The Isparta region of Turkey is the cradle of this sublime flower. The tradition of picking the Damascus rose at dawn produces, after distilling, an essential oil with honeyed and fruity tones. Combined with a touch of indulgent praline, the fragrance gains a new velvety texture and depth.

Jasmine absolute: Originating in India, Jasmine grandiflorum is the first flower to be cultivated by humans. Jasmine absolute gives perfume a warm, smooth, voluptuous sensuality. These dazzling facets shine in harmony and resonate with the solar accord.

HISTORY OF FRAGRANCE

Annick Menardo, the perfumer behind the emblematic Eau de Parfum Comme une Evidence, has reinterpreted each facet of the fragrance, revealing a more intense and sensual formula.

“This new perfume is a more intense version of my original creation Comme Une Evidence. I enriched the floral heart with a solar accord to make it denser and more carnal. At the base, perfume reveals the intense sensuality of its scent through powerful, vibrant, magnetic white woods combined with the indulgent tones of praline. This enhances the richness of the formula reinforcing its depth and modernity.”

title: Legend Eau De Toilette Spray Men by Mont Blanc, 1.7 fl. oz
bullet_point: [The brand Mont Blanc presents a new men's fragrance in April 2011, Legend is dedicated to inspiring, virtuous and self-confident men who are courageous, passionate and authentic, Their fragrance is subtle but striking and masculine]
description:
The brand Mont Blanc presents a new men's fragrance in April 2011. Legend is dedicated to inspiring, virtuous and self-confident men who are courageous, passionate and authentic. Their fragrance is subtle but striking and masculine. Olivier Pescheux, the perfumer behind this fresh fougere creation, tried to make the fragrance filled with contrasts, combining notes that evoke strength and tenderness, tradition and modernity. The composition opens with fresh aromatic tones of bergamot, lavender, pineapple leaf and exotic verbena (Lit sea Cubeb a). The heart emphasizes oak moss note (evernyl molecule) merged with geranium, coumarone, apple, rose, and Pomarosa molecule (notes of dried fruit). The base contains sandalwood, Tonka and evernyl. Heavy and slightly curved bottle of black and metallic colors is inspired by the famous Meisterstuck pen design, made of glass and metal. The design is minimalistic and luxurious, perfect for the concept behind this fragrance. The black and white campaign features Simon Clark photographed by Peter Lindbergh. Legend is available as 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette. This product is manufactured in France.

המותג Mont Blanc מציג ניחוח חדש לגברים באפריל 2011. האגדה מסורה לגברים מעוררי השראה, מוסרי ביטחון עצמי שהם אמיצים, נלהבים ואותנטיים. הניחוח שלהם עדין אך מרשים וגברי. Olivier Pescheux, הבשם מאחורי היצירה הרעננה הזו, ניסה להפוך את הניחוח למולא בניגודים, שילוב הערות המעוררות חוזק ורכות, מסורת ומודרניות. ההרכב נפתח עם גוונים ארומטיים טריים של ברגמוט, לבנדר, עלי אננס וורבנה אקזוטית (קוביית ים ליט א). הלב מדגיש פתק אזוב אלון (מולקולת evernyl) ממוזג עם גרניום, קומרון, תפוח, ורד ומולקולת פומרוסה (הערות של פירות יבשים). הבסיס מכיל אלגום, Tonka ו-everNyl. בקבוק כבד ומעוקל מעט בצבעים שחור ומתכתיים בהשראת העיצוב המפורסם של עט Meisterstuck, עשוי מזכוכית ומתכת. העיצוב מינימליסטי ויוקרתי, מושלם לרעיון מאחורי הניחוח הזה. הקמפיין השחור והלבן כולל את סימון קלארק שצולם על ידי פיטר לינדברג. האגדה זמינה כ-30, 50 ו-100 מ"ל או דה טואלט. מוצר זה מיוצר בצרפת.

Die Marke Mont Blanc präsentiert im April 2011 einen neuen Herrenduft. Legend widmet sich inspirierende, tugendliche und selbstbewusste Männer, die mutig, leidenschaftlich und authentisch sind. Ihr Duft ist dezent, aber auffallend und maskulin. Olivier Pescheux, der Parfümeur hinter dieser frischen Fouger-Kreation, versuchte den Duft voller Kontraste zu kreieren, der Noten kombiniert, die Stärke und Zärtlichkeit, Tradition und Moderne hervorrufen. Die Komposition öffnet sich mit frischen aromatischen Tönen von Bergamotte, Lavendel, Ananasblatt und exotischem Eisenkraut (Lit Sea Cubeb a). Das Herz betont die Eichenmoosnote (Evernylmolekül), die mit Geranie, Coumaron, Apfel, Rose und Pomarosa Molekül (Noten von getrockneten Früchten). Die Basis enthält Sandelholz, Tonka und Evernyl. Schwere und leicht geschwungene Flasche mit schwarzen und metallischen Farben ist inspiriert vom berühmten Meisterstick-Stift-Design, aus Glas und Metall. Das Design ist minimalistisch und luxuriös, perfekt für das Konzept hinter diesem Duft. Die schwarz-weiße Kampagne zeigt Simon Clark fotografiert von Peter Lindbergh. Legend ist erhältlich als 30, 50 und 100 ml Eau de Toilette. Hergestellt in Frankreich.

تقدم العلامة التجارية مونت بلانك عطرًا جديدًا للرجال في أبريل 2011. تكرس ليجند جهودها للرجال الملهمين والذين يثقون بأنفسهم بالشجاعة والشغف والأصيل. عطرها رقيق ولكنه جذاب وذكوري. لقد حاولت أوليفر بيشيكس، صانع العطور الذي خلف هذا العطر المنعش أن يصنع العطر مليء بالتباينات ويجمع بين الروائح التي تثير القوة والحيوية والتقاليد والحداثة. تبدأ التركيبة بروائح عطرية منعشة من البرغموت واللافندر وأوراق الأناناس وعشب الفيربينا الغريب (مكعبات البحر الواحدة). يركز القلب على نوتة طحلب البلوط (جزيء الأفيرنيل) الممزوج مع إبرة الراعي والكومارون والتفاح والورد وجزيء البوماروسا (روائح الفاكهة المجففة). تحتوي القاعدة على خشب الصندل والتونكا والأفريلين. زجاجة ثقيلة ومنحنية قليلاً من الألوان السوداء والمعدنية مستوحاة من تصميم القلم ميستر ستاك الشهير، المصنوع من الزجاج والمعدن. التصميم بسيط وفاخر ومثالي للمفهوم وراء هذا العطر. تتميز الحملة باللونين الأبيض والأسود بصورة سيمون كلارك من بيتر ليندبرغ. ليجند متوفرة بحجم 30 و50 و100 مل او دي تواليت صُنع هذا المنتج في فرنسا.

A marca Mont Blanc apresenta uma nova fragrância masculina em abril de 2011. Legend é dedicada a homens inspiradores, virtuosos e autoconfiantes que são corajosos, apaixonados e autênticos. Sua fragrância é sutil, mas impressionante e masculina. Olivier Pescheux, o perfumista por trás desta nova criação fougera, tentou fazer a fragrância cheia de contraste, combinando notas que evocam força e delicadeza, tradição e modernidade. A composição abre com tons aromáticos frescos de bergamota, lavanda, folha de abacaxi e verbena exótica (Lit Sea Cubeb a). O coração enfatiza a nota de musgo de carvalho (molécula de evernil) mesclada com gerânio, cumarônia, maçã, rosa e molécula de pomarosa (notas de frutas secas). A base contém sândalo, Tonka e evernyl. A garrafa pesada e ligeiramente curvada de cores pretas e metálicas é inspirada no famoso design de caneta Meisterstuck, feita de vidro e metal. O design é minimalista e luxuoso, perfeito para o conceito por trás desta fragrância. A campanha em preto e branco apresenta Simon Clark fotografado por Peter Lindbergh. Legend está disponível como 30, 50 e 100 ml Eau de Toilette. Este produto é fabricado na França.

Mont Blanc 品牌於 2011 年 4 月推出全新男士香氛。 Legend 致力於鼓舞人心、善良和自信的男性,他們勇敢、熱情和真實。 香味微妙但引人注目,陽剛。 Olivier Pescheux 是這一清新富格創作背後的香水師,試圖將香味充滿對比,結合了讓人聯想到力量和柔情、傳統和現代性的音符。 這款組合物以佛手柑、薰衣草、鳳梨葉和異國情調的馬鞭草 (Lit sea Cubeb a) 等清新芳香色調開啟。 心臟強調橡木苔香 (evernyl 分子) 與天竺葵、香馬龍、蘋果、玫瑰和桃紅分子(乾果香)結合。 底座包含檀香、Tonka 和 evernyl。 濃度和微彎的黑色和金屬顏色靈感來自著名的 Meisterstuck 筆設計,由玻璃和金屬製成。 簡約奢華的設計,完美詮釋這款香味背後的概念。 黑白戰役的特點是 Simon Clark 由 Peter Lindbergh 拍攝。 Legend 提供 30、50 和 100 毫升淡香水。 本產品在法國製造。

Mont Blanc 品牌于 2011 年 4 月推出新款男士香水。 Legend 致力于激励、勇气、热情和真实自信的男士。 其香味微妙但引人注目和阳刚。 Olivier Pescheux 是这款清新古朴作品背后的香水师,试图让香味充满对比,结合唤起力量和柔嫩、传统和现代的香调。 成分打开时充满了佛手柑、薰衣草、菠萝叶和异国情调的马鞭草(香海立方体)。 心脏强调橡木苔(常尼分子)与天竺葵、香茅、苹果、玫瑰和波马罗萨分子(干果的香调)合并。 底座包含檀香、Tonka 和 everNyl。 重而略微弯曲的黑色和金属色瓶的灵感来自著名的 Meisterstuck 笔设计，由玻璃和金属制成。 这款设计简约奢华,非常适合这款香水背后的概念。 黑白战役以彼得林伯格拍摄的Simon Clark为特色。 Legend 有 30、50 和 100 毫升淡香水。 本产品为法国制造。

Mont Blanc 브랜드는 2011년 4월에 새로운 남성용 향기를 선보입니다. Legend는 용감하고 열정적이며 진실한 사람들에게 영감을 주고 유덕하며 자신감있는 남성들에게 헌신합니다. 그들의 향기는 미묘하지만 눈에 띄고 남성적입니다. Olivier Pescheux는 이 신선한 푸제르 창작의 조향사로, 강도와 부드러움, 전통, 현대성을 불러일으키는 노트를 결합하여 대비로 가득 찬 향기를 만들려고 노력했습니다. 베르가못, 라벤더, 파인애플 잎 및 이국적인 버베나(Lit sea Cubeb a)의 신선한 아로마 톤으로 구성되어 있습니다. 심장은 제라늄, 쿠마론, 사과, 로즈, 포마로사 분자(말린 과일 노트)와 결합된 오크 이끼 노트(에버 닐 분자)를 강조합니다. 베이스에는 샌달우드, 통카 및 에버나일론이 포함되어 있습니다. 묵직하고 약간 구부러진 블랙 및 메탈릭 색상의 병은 유리와 금속으로 만든 유명한 Meisterstuck 펜 디자인에서 영감을 얻었습니다. 미니멀리즘과 고급스러우며 이 향기의 컨셉에 완벽하게 어울리는 디자인입니다. 흑백 캠페인은 피터 린드버그가 촬영한 사이먼 클라크가 특징입니다. 레전드는 30, 50, 100ml 오드 뚜왈렛으로 제공됩니다. 이 제품은 프랑스에서 제조되었습니다.

title: Jardin de le Ntre by Historiae: Perfume of History- Purse Size
bullet_point: [Paris Chamber of Commerce featured perfume, 1 purse size (0.50 fl oz) bottle, Top Notes: Green leaves, Green accord, dewdrop, Tulip, pink pepper extract, Middle/Heart Notes: Narcissus absolute, Hyacinth, water jasmine, rose, Lily of the valley, gardenia, Base Notes: Marine notes, musk, white cedarwood, vetiver oil, patchouli oil]
description:
Historiae Perfume of History
In 2012, Pascale Oger was living in a 17th century home, called "The Kings Falconry", in the Versailles Plain, when she was working for L'Oreal. The scenery around her inspired the basis for her new luxury perfume line to tell the history of France with scents: Historiae, Perfume of History. This line is 100% made in France, and is the perfect embodiment of the know-how, creativity and culture of the French throughout history. Each perfume has its own perfume creator and designer, who specializes in international luxury brands, that makes each perfume its own unique creation. Only one year after its debut, Historiae was awarded 1st place for "Primo Exportatuer" (or "Best Exporter") in 2013 by the Paris Chamber of Commerce.

Jardin de le Ntre
A most poetic sequence of scents, this perfume was inspired by the gardens of Andre le Notre, the famous French landscape architect for King Louis XIV. This aromatic venture begins with notes of fresh morning dew and newly manicured landscape. Your nose leads you to the heart of the garden with subtle scents of narcissus, water jasmine and gardenia. You can smell the moist soil under your feet, fresh and crisp, with hints of patchouli and vetiver leading you closer to the woods on the other side of the garden. After reaching the forest, you're left with the sweet and sensual aroma of musk. This perfume is as close to visiting the Gardens of Versailles as one can get, without the expensive plane ride!

The Perfect "Any Occasion" Gift!
Flowers are the typical gift for women in our lives, however the stems wilt and the blooms will inevitably perish. Why not give her a bouquet that lasts year-round? With combined floral scents of tulip, lilly of the valley, gardenia, jasmine and rose; you will rest assured that she will be pleased, and might even thank you twice!
